萬曆二年進士登科錄

玉音

萬曆二年三月初八日，禮部左侍郎兼翰林院侍讀學士臣汪鏜等於皇極門奏，為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中三百名。本年三月十五日殿試，合擬讀卷官及執事等官，少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士張居正等六十員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。」欽此。

讀卷官
光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士張居正〔丁未進士〕

光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、兵部尚書兼都察院右副都御史、協理京營戎政王崇古〔辛丑進士〕
translation_en:
Record of Successful Candidates in the Palace Examination for Metropolitan Graduates in the Second Year of the Wanli Reign (1574)

Imperial Pronouncement

On the eighth day of the third month of the second year of the Wanli reign (March 30, 1574), Your Servant Wang Tang 汪鏜, Left Vice Minister of Rites and concurrently Hanlin Academician Reader-in-Waiting, and others submitted a memorial at the Gate of Imperial Supremacy (Huangji men) regarding the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates from across the realm, three hundred candidates have been selected as passing. For the Palace Examination to be held on the fifteenth day of the third month of the present year (April 6, 1574), it is appropriate to nominate sixty officials to serve as Readers of Examination Papers and functioning officials, headed by Zhang Juzheng 張居正, Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Supremacy (Zhongji dian). As for the classification and status of the metropolitan graduates, in reverent accordance with the qualifications imperially established by Emperor Taizu the Exalted: in the First Class (jia), three candidates are by rule selected, with the first-place candidate ranked at Sub-Sixth Rank (cong liupin) and the second- and third-place candidates ranked at Principal Seventh Rank (zheng qipin), all conferred the degree of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class are ranked at Sub-Seventh Rank (cong qipin) and conferred the status of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); those in the Third Class are ranked at Principal Eighth Rank (zheng bapin) and conferred the status of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen).

An Imperial Edict was received: "Approved." Respect this!

Readers of Examination Papers (Dujuan guan)

Zhang Juzheng 張居正, Grandee of the Sixteenth Class (Guanglu dafu), Pillar of State (Zhuguo), Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Supremacy (Zhongji dian) [Metropolitan Graduate of the dingwei year, 1547].

Lü Diaoyang 呂調陽, Grandee of the Seventeenth Class (Ronglu dafu), Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Rites and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Prowess (Wuying dian) [Metropolitan Graduate of the gengxu year, 1550].

Wang Chonggu 王崇古, Grandee of the Sixteenth Class (Guanglu dafu), Pillar of State (Zhuguo), Junior Guardian and concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Minister of War and concurrently Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, Assisting in the Administration of the Capital Training Divisions [Metropolitan Graduate of the xinchou year, 1541].

三月十九日，
translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors
Early on the fifteenth day of the third month of the second year of the Wanli reign (1574), the tribute scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. His Majesty ascended the Hall of Imperial Supremacy (Huangji dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.
Early on the eighteenth day of the third month, the civil and military officials attended in court dress in their respective ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard set out the imperial insignia upon the Cinnabar Steps and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. His Majesty ascended the Hall of Imperial Supremacy, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names on the roll. Officials of the Ministry of Rites bore the yellow placard, led by drums and music out through the Left Chang'an Gate, where they posted it. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture escorted the Optimus (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with parasols, canopies, and ceremonial retinue.
On the nineteenth day of the third month, …

translation_en:
… the Emperor bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites. When the banquet ended, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.

On the twenty-first day of the third month, the Principal Graduate was bestowed court robes, a cap, and a belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).

On the twenty-second day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in presenting a memorial of gratitude for Imperial grace.

On the twenty-third day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). At the petition of the Ministry of Rites, an Imperial command was issued to the Ministry of Works to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education.

余孟麟〔貫應天府江寧縣民籍，直隸徽州府祁門縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字伯祥，行一，年三十七，十一月初二日生〕。曾祖仕英，祖隆〔累贈文林郎、監察御史〕，父光〔監察御史〕，前母謝氏〔贈孺人〕，母黃氏〔封孺人〕。慈侍下。娶金氏。應天府鄉試第九十四名，會試第十六名。

translation_en:
First Tier (diyi jia), 3 candidates, granted the status of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi):

Sun Jigao 孫繼皐 [registered in a civilian household of Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yide; seniority 1; age 25, born on the 18th day of the 8th month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Li, his grandfather was Sun Youliang, his father is Sun Chen, his father's former wife was Lady Liu, and his mother is Lady Liu. Both parents are living (juqing xia). He married Lady Cao. He placed 42nd in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 33rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Menglin 余孟麟 [registered in a civilian household of Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, originally from Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Boxiang; seniority 1; age 37, born on the 2nd day of the 11th month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Shiying; his grandfather was Yu Long [posthumously promoted through successive grants to Gentleman for Literature (wenlin lang) and Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi)]; his father was Yu Guang [Investigating Censor]; his father's former wife was Lady Xie [posthumously titled Child Nurturer (ruren)]; and his mother is Lady Huang [invested as Child Nurturer (ruren)]. His mother is living (cishi xia). He married Lady Jin. He placed 94th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 16th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yingxuan 王應選 [registered in a civilian household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Junqing; seniority 5; age 36, born on the 18th day of the 5th month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Gang, his grandfather was Wang You [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)], his father was Wang Liangcai [Prefectural Instructor (jiaoshou)], and his mother was Lady Chen. Both parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brothers are Yingqiu, Zhu [Vice Prefect (fu tongzhi)], Yingchun, Yingkui [Commissioner (dashi) [?]], Yingxiang, and Yi [County Magistrate (zhixian)]. He married Lady Chen. He placed 6th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 2nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xixian 周希賢 [registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under a salt-producer household; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Siqian; fourth in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zheng 周政; his grandfather was Zhou Hao 周皓; his father was Zhou Fuxiang 周夫祥; his mother is née Huang 黃氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhou Xishu 周希書, Zhou Xichen 周希臣, and Zhou Xizheng 周希正; his younger brother is Zhou Xiyu 周希遇. He married née Lin 林氏. He placed 78th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 36th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Pan 王泮 [registered in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under a civilian household; a Directorate Student (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zonglu; first in his generation; age forty, born on the sixth day of the seventh month]. punctuated:
孫鑛，貫錦衣衛官籍，浙江紹興府餘姚縣人，國子生。治《易經》，字文融，行三十五，年三十二，三月初八日生。曾祖新〔贈禮部尚書，加贈榮祿大夫〕；祖燧〔巡撫江西右副都御史，贈禮部尚書，謚忠烈，加贈榮祿大夫〕；父陞〔南京禮部尚書，贈太子少保，謚文恪〕；前母韓氏〔贈夫人〕；母楊氏〔封太夫人〕。慈侍下。兄鑨〔光祿寺署丞〕、鈺〔縣主簿〕、鈳〔府同知〕、王〔後府都事，贈太僕寺少卿〕、久〔刑部管〕、𢡟〔雲南按察司副使〕、鋌〔南京禮部右侍郎〕、錝〔前監察御史〕；弟鑲。娶胡氏。順天府鄉試第四十七名，會試第一名。

沈璟，貫直隸蘇州府吳江縣軍籍，縣學生。治《書經》，字伯英，行一，年二十二，二月十四日生。曾祖漢〔戶科左給事中，贈太常寺少卿〕；祖嘉謨〔上林苑監署丞〕；父侃〔監生〕；母卜氏。重慶下。弟瓚、璨。娶閔氏。應天府鄉試第十七名，會試第三名。

馬慥，貫陝西西安府同州軍籍，國子生。治《春秋》，字顧甫，行二，年二十九，十一月初一日生。曾祖通〔知縣，累贈通議大夫、詹事府詹事兼翰林院侍讀學士〕；祖珍〔縣丞，累贈通議大夫、詹事府詹事兼翰林院侍讀學士〕；父自強〔禮部左侍郎兼翰林院侍讀學士，掌詹事府事〕；母李氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下。兄慎、忱、恬、怡〔貢士〕、恊、憬；弟惺。娶張氏。陝西鄉試第九名，會試第二百五十二名。

陸檄，貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，府學生。治《易經》，字羽行，行一，年三十三，六月初八日生。曾祖𫔎；祖璋；父文聰；母褚氏。嚴侍下。弟楨、模、校。娶顧氏，繼娶尤氏。應天府鄉試第二名，會試第二十七名。
translation_en:
Sun Kuang 孫鑛, registered under an official household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard and a native of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), had the courtesy name Wenrong, was thirty-fifth in his generational line, and was thirty-two sui, born on the eighth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Sun Xin (posthumously honored as Minister of Rites, with the added posthumous prestige title Grand Master for Glorious Happiness); his grandfather was Sun Sui (Right Vice Censor-in-chief and Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi, posthumously honored as Minister of Rites, canonized as Zhonglie, with the added posthumous prestige title Grand Master for Glorious Happiness); his father was Sun Sheng (Nanjing Minister of Rites, posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Wenke); his father's first wife was Lady Han (posthumously honored as Lady of the First Rank); and his mother is Lady Yang (enfeoffed as Dowager Lady of the First Rank). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Sun Long (Assistant Director of a Service in the Court of Imperial Entertainments), Sun Yu (County Recorder), Sun Ke (Prefectural Vice Prefect), Sun Wang [?] (Office Manager of the Rear Chief Military Commission, posthumously honored as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud), Sun Jiu [?] (official in the Ministry of Justice [?]), Sun Nian [?] (Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Yunnan), Sun Ting (Nanjing Right Vice Minister of Rites), and Sun Cong (former Investigating Censor); his younger brother is Sun Xiang. He married Lady Hu. He placed forty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Jing 沈璟, registered under a military household of Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili), was a county school student. He specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing), had the courtesy name Boying, was first in his generational line, and was twenty-two sui, born on the fourteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Shen Han (Left Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue, posthumously honored as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices); his grandfather is Shen Jiamo (Assistant Director of an Office in the Directorate of Imperial Parks); his father is Shen Kan (Student of the Directorate of Education); and his mother is Lady Bu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Shen Zan and Shen Can. He married Lady Min. He placed seventeenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Cao 馬慥, registered under a military household of Tongzhou Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), had the courtesy name Gufu, was second in his generational line, and was twenty-nine sui, born on the first day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Ma Tong (County Magistrate, cumulatively posthumously honored as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Supervisor of the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent concurrent with Expositor-in-waiting Academician of the Hanlin Academy); his grandfather was Ma Zhen (Assistant County Magistrate, cumulatively posthumously honored as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Supervisor of the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent concurrent with Expositor-in-waiting Academician of the Hanlin Academy); his father is Ma Ziqiang (Left Vice Minister of Rites concurrent with Expositor-in-waiting Academician of the Hanlin Academy, in charge of the affairs of the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent); and his mother is Lady Li (enfeoffed as Lady of Virtue). Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Ma Shen, Ma Chen, Ma Tian, Ma Yi (tribute student [gongshi]), Ma Xie, and Ma Jing; his younger brother is Ma Xing. He married Lady Zhang. He placed ninth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Xi 陸檄, registered under a civilian household of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili), was a prefectural school student. He specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), had the courtesy name Yuxing, was first in his generational line, and was thirty-three sui, born on the eighth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Lu Gun [?]; his grandfather was Lu Zhang; his father is Lu Wencong; and his mother was Lady Chu. His father is living. His younger brothers are Lu Zhen, Lu Mo, and Lu Xiao. He married Lady Gu, and remarried Lady You. He placed second in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳顯　貫福建漳州府漳浦縣民籍　縣學附學生
治詩經字景猷行二年二十五十月十三日生
曾祖夢麒〔貢士〕　祖承孝　父淵　母李氏
具慶下　兄汝順　昭〔貢士〕　弟槐　梗　策　第　娶陳氏

punctuated:
林纘振〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣，民籍，府學生。治《詩經》，字公說，行一，年二十五，八月二十八日生〕。曾祖秀桂〔貢士〕；祖衍續；父舉祈，母吳氏。重慶下。弟纘持、纘揚、纘扶、纘掖。娶方氏。福建鄉試第八十三名，會試第七名。

蕭景訓〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣，軍籍，縣學附學生。治《易經》，字希之，行三，年二十七，十一月初十日生〕。曾祖淦；祖軻；父懷恭，母曾氏。具慶下。兄景周、景和；弟景星、景運。娶張氏，繼娶劉氏。江西鄉試第十五名，會試第一百十七名。

蕭應宮〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣，民籍，縣學生。治《易經》，字伯和，行一，年三十一，十一月初四日生〕。曾祖繹〔訓導〕；祖詔；父仕〔冠帶生員〕，母徐氏。慈侍下。弟應商、應角、應塤、應徵、應羽、應律、應篪、應柷、應呂。娶龐氏。應天府鄉試第六十七名，會試第三十一名。

吳顯〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣，民籍，縣學附學生。治《詩經》，字景猷，行二，年二十五，十月十三日生〕。曾祖夢麒〔貢士〕；祖承孝；父瀾，母李氏。具慶下。兄汝頌、昭〔生員〕；弟槐、梗、策、第。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第三十六名，會試第八十七名。
translation_en:
Lin Zuanzhen 林纘振: Native of Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian registration, a student of the Prefectural School. He specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), has the courtesy name Gongshuo 公說, is first in seniority among his brothers, and is twenty-five sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Lin Xiugui 林秀桂 (Tribute Student [gongshi]); his grandfather is Lin Yanxu 林衍續; his father is Lin Juqi 林舉祈, and his mother is née Wu 吳. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Lin Zuanchi 林纘持, Lin Zuanyang 林纘揚, Lin Zuanfu 林纘扶, and Lin Zuanye 林纘掖. He married née Fang 方. He placed 83rd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 7th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Jingxun 蕭景訓: Native of Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, of military registration, a supplementary student of the County School. He specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), has the courtesy name Xizhi 希之, is third in seniority among his brothers, and is twenty-seven sui, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Xiao Gan 蕭淦; his grandfather was Xiao Ke 蕭軻; his father is Xiao Huaigong 蕭懷恭, and his mother is née Zeng 曾. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiao Jingzhou 蕭景周 and Xiao Jinghe 蕭景和; his younger brothers are Xiao Jingxing 蕭景星 and Xiao Jingyun 蕭景運. He married née Zhang 張, and subsequently married née Liu 劉. He placed 15th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 117th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Yinggong 蕭應宮: Native of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), of civilian registration, a student of the County School. He specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), has the courtesy name Bohe 伯和, is first in seniority among his brothers, and is thirty-one sui, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Xiao Yi 蕭繹 (Assistant Instructor [xundao]); his grandfather was Xiao Zhao 蕭詔; his father was Xiao Shi 蕭仕 (Government Student with ceremonial cap and belt [guandai shengyuan]), and his mother is née Xu 徐. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Xiao Yingshang 蕭應商, Xiao Yingjue 蕭應角, Xiao Yingxun 蕭應塤, Xiao Yingzhi 蕭應徵, Xiao Yingyu 蕭應羽, Xiao Yinglü 蕭應律, Xiao Yingchi 蕭應篪, Xiao Yingzhu 蕭應柷, and Xiao Yinglü 蕭應呂. He married née Pang 龐. He placed 67th in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and 31st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Xian 吳顯: Native of Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian registration, a supplementary student of the County School. He specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), has the courtesy name Jingyou 景猷, is second in seniority among his brothers, and is twenty-five sui, born on the thirteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wu Mengqi 吳夢麒 (Tribute Student [gongshi]); his grandfather was Wu Chengxiao 吳承孝; his father is Wu Lan 吳瀾, and his mother is née Li 李. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Rusong 吳汝頌 and Wu Zhao 吳昭 (Government Student [shengyuan]); his younger brothers are Wu Huai 吳槐, Wu Geng 吳梗, Wu Ce 吳策, and Wu Di 吳第. He married née Chen 陳. He placed 36th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 87th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
陳大統〔貫浙江紹興府會稽縣官籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字一甫，行九，年三十一，八月二十三日生〕。曾祖繹〔百戶〕；祖瑞〔百戶〕；父鵠〔按察司僉事〕；前母吳氏，母朱氏。具慶下。兄大綸〔都指揮使〕、大綱、大維、大經〔監生〕、大紀；弟大纓、大綺、大綬、大績、大繪。娶胡氏。浙江鄉試第二名，會試第二百三十五名。
薛道生〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣民籍，太倉州人，國子生，治《易經》，字士立，行一，年三十一，八月初三日生〕。曾祖槐；祖輅；父里；母羅氏。具慶下。娶沈氏。應天府鄉試第十八名，會試第一百七十一名。
管大燿〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字德臣，行二十四，年三十四，正月十六日生〕。曾祖傑；祖澤；父椿；母史氏。具慶下。兄大勳〔按察司提學副使〕；弟大穀〔貢士〕、大炯、大煒、大燁、大熠、大獎。娶董氏。浙江鄉試第三十八名，會試第三十七名。
陳九叙〔貫福建漳州府漳平縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字爾纘，行一，年三十九，十二月十三日生〕。曾祖文應〔陰陽訓術〕；祖翀〔縣主簿〕；父如璠〔冠帶生員〕；母王氏，繼母林氏。慈侍下。弟九仞〔知府〕、九偕〔監生〕、九禮、九儀、九牧、九遷、九聘、九卿。娶翁氏。福建鄉試第七名，會試第二百六十九名。
translation_en:
Chen Datong 陳大統, courtesy name Yifu 一甫, ninth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month, was registered under an official household in Kuaiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, and served as a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Chen Yi 繹 (Company Commander), his grandfather was Chen Rui 瑞 (Company Commander), his father is Chen Gu 鵠 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner), his father's former wife was Lady Wu 吳氏, and his mother is Lady Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Dalun 大綸 (Regional Military Commissioner), Chen Dagang 大綱, Chen Dawei 大維, Chen Dajing 大經 (National University Student), and Chen Daji 大紀; his younger brothers are Chen Daying 大纓, Chen Daqi 大綺, Chen Dashou 大綬, Chen Daji 大績, and Chen Dahui 大繪. He married Lady Hu 胡氏. He placed second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Daosheng 薛道生, courtesy name Shili 士立, first in seniority, aged thirty-one, born on the third day of the eighth month, was a native of Taicang Subprefecture registered under a commoner household in Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), and was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Xue Huai 槐, his grandfather was Xue Lu 輅, his father is Xue Li 里, and his mother is Lady Luo 羅氏. Both of his parents are living. He married Lady Shen 沈氏. He placed eighteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and 171st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guan Dayao 管大燿, courtesy name Dechen 德臣, twenty-fourth in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the first month, was registered under a commoner household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Guan Jie 傑, his grandfather was Guan Ze 澤, his father is Guan Chun 椿, and his mother is Lady Shi 史氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Guan Daxun 大勳 (Education Intendant Vice Surveillance Commissioner); his younger brothers are Guan Dagu 大穀 (Tribute Student), Guan Dajiong 大炯, Guan Dawei 大煒, Guan Daye 大燁, Guan Dayi 大熠, and Guan Dajiang 大獎. He married Lady Dong 董氏. He placed thirty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Jiuxu 陳九叙, courtesy name Erzuan 爾纘, first in seniority, aged thirty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, was registered under a military household in Zhangping County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Chen Wenying 文應 (Divination Instructor), his grandfather was Chen Chong 翀 (County Assistant Magistrate), his father was Chen Rufan 如璠 (Government Student with Cap and Belt), his mother was Lady Wang 王氏, and his stepmother is Lady Lin 林氏. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Chen Jiuren 九仞 (Prefect), Chen Jiuxie 九偕 (National University Student), Chen Jiuli 九禮, Chen Jiuyi 九儀, Chen Jiumu 九牧, Chen Jiuqian 九遷, Chen Jiupin 九聘, and Chen Jiuqing 九卿. He married Lady Weng 翁氏. He placed seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

佘毅中〔貫直隸池州府銅陵縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子執，行三，年三十三，九月二十六日生〕。曾祖理；祖永江〔義官〕；父傑〔知縣，封吏部員外郎〕；前母吳氏〔贈安人〕；母羅氏。具慶下。兄敬中〔按察司按察使〕、弘中〔監生〕；弟吉中、慶中。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第一名，會試第三十二名。

雷應志〔貫山西太原府陽曲縣民籍，陝西西安府華州華陰縣人，陽曲縣學生，治《詩經》，字立甫，行三，年三十二，八月初一日生〕。曾祖霆〔典史〕；祖相〔儀賓，封亞中大夫〕；父鳴〔知縣〕；母孔氏。永感下。兄應龍、應虹〔儀賓〕；弟國華〔儀賓〕、國棟、國綬。娶張氏。山西鄉試第四十九名，會試第二百十二名。

王任〔貫四川潼川州軍籍，州學生，治《易經》，字仁卿，行一，年二十三，八月十二日生〕。曾祖時迪；祖瑄；父汝善；母劉氏。具慶下。弟佐。娶汪氏。四川鄉試第六十二名，會試第二百五十六名。

吳同春〔貫河南汝寧府光州固始縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字伯與，行一，年三十一，七月十二日生〕。曾祖廣義；祖純；父梅；母聞氏。具慶下。弟同泰。娶閻氏。河南鄉試第五十三名，會試第二十六名。
translation_en:
She Yizhong 佘毅中 (registered in a military household in Tongling County, Chizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Zizhi, third in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was She Li; his grandfather was She Yongjiang (Righteousness Official); his father was She Jie (District Magistrate, enfeoffed as Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel); his father's former wife was née Wu (posthumously titled Lady of Tranquility); his mother is née Luo. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are She Jingzhong (Surveillance Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission) and She Hongzhong (National University Student); his younger brothers are She Jizhong and She Qingzhong. He married née Wu. He placed 1st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 32nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lei Yingzhi 雷應志 (registered in a civilian household in Yangqu County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, originally from Huayin County, Hua Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; County Student of Yangqu County, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Lifu, third in seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Lei Ting (Unclassified Subofficial); his grandfather was Lei Xiang (Ceremonial Companion, enfeoffed as Lesser Grand Master of the Palace); his father was Lei Ming (District Magistrate); his mother was née Kong. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Lei Yinglong and Lei Yinghong (Ceremonial Companion); his younger brothers are Lei Guohua (Ceremonial Companion), Lei Guodong, and Lei Guoshou. He married née Zhang. He placed 49th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 212th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ren 王任 (registered in a military household in Tongchuan Subprefecture, Sichuan; Subprefectural Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes; style name Renqing, first in seniority, aged twenty-three, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Shidi; his grandfather was Wang Xuan; his father is Wang Rushan; his mother is née Liu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Wang Zuo. He married née Wang. He placed 62nd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 256th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Tongchun 吳同春 (registered in a civilian household in Gushi County, Guang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan; Supernumerary County Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Boyu, first in seniority, aged thirty-one, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Guangyi; his grandfather was Wu Chun; his father is Wu Mei; his mother is née Wen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Wu Tongtai. He married née Yan. He placed 53rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 26th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Yuanlin 石元麟 [registered in a military household in Danyang County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili); a native of Yongchang Prefecture, Yunnan; a supernumerary student of the Yongchang Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Junding; second in generational seniority; age twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Wengui [Honorary Official for Longevity], his grandfather was Shi Zhongli [Honorary Official for Longevity], his father is Shi Lei [Assistant Prefect], and his mother is née Zhao. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yuanqi, and his younger brothers are Yuanlong, Yuanfeng, and Yuanpeng. He married née Liu. He placed 40th in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Menggeng 陳夢庚 [registered in a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili); a supernumerary student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Taixi; first in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the seventh day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Yi, his grandfather was Chen Tianfeng, his father is Chen Zhen [Assistant Instructor by Grace Regulation], his father's former wife was née Tang, his mother was née Sun, and his stepmother is née Shen. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Sijia. He married née Mo. He placed 19th in the Yingtian Prefectural (Nanjing) Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Qiu 謝裘 [registered in a civilian household in Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili); a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zimei; fifth in generational seniority; age thirty-three, born on the eleventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Yu, his grandfather was Xie You, his father is Xie Dun [Instructor], and his mother was née Xia. His father is living. His elder brothers are Biao, Yi, and Shang. He married née Hu. He placed 73rd in the Yingtian Prefectural (Nanjing) Provincial Examination and 76th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zhenxian 張振先 [registered in a civilian household in Lin'an County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a native of Qiantang County; a student of the Lin'an County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenqi; first in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Kai, his grandfather was Zhang Jie, his father was Zhang Luan, his legal mothers were née Li and née Chen, and his birth mother is née Du. His mother is living. He married née Shen, and remarried to née Qu. He placed 35th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 102nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐元春〔貫錦衣衛官籍，直隸松江府華亭縣人，順天府學附學生，治《易經》，字正夫，行一，年二十七，十二月三十日生〕。曾祖黼〔縣丞，贈特進光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、建極殿大學士〕；祖階〔特進光祿大夫、柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、建極殿大學士〕；父璠〔通議大夫、太常寺卿〕；母季氏〔封孺人，贈淑人〕。重慶下。弟元普〔監生〕、元思〔錦衣衛衣中所正千戶〕、元悊〔官生〕、元應〔官生〕、元憲、元性、元相、元暘、元昭、元煦、元材、元暉、元寀。娶朱氏。順天府鄉試第二十五名，會試第二十三名。

translation_en:
Cai Qianfu 蔡乾釜 (registered in a civilian household of Longxi County 龍溪縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education [guozisheng 國子生]; specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Yiheng 宜亨; second in seniority among brothers; thirty-one sui, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Cai Dong 蔡棟; his grandfather was Cai Quan 蔡權; his father is Cai Chen 蔡琛; his mother was née Zhang 張氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Cai Qianju 蔡乾鋦; his younger brothers are Cai Qian'ao 蔡乾鏊 (National University Student [jiansheng 監生]), Cai Chaobin 蔡朝賓, Cai Chaopin 蔡朝聘, and Cai Qianliu 蔡乾鎏. He married née Du 杜氏, and subsequently married née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 9th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 94th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Guobin 余國賓 (registered in a civilian household of Xi'an County 西安縣, Quzhou Prefecture 衢州府, Zhejiang; Prefectural Student; specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji 禮記]; courtesy name Shuxian 叔賢; thirty-second in seniority in his generation; thirty-two sui, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Cheng 余誠 (Vice Magistrate); his grandfather was Yu Zonghong 余宗洪 (Honorary Official of the Seventh Rank); his father was Yu Zhe 余𦶜 (District Magistrate); his mother was née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yu Guoying 余國英 (Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate), Yu Guoqi 余國器, Yu Guozhu 余國柱, and Yu Guoyan 余國彥; his younger brothers are Yu Guoqu 余國衢, Yu Guocai 余國材, Yu Guozhou 余國州, and Yu Guoxiang 余國祥. He married née Ye 葉氏. He placed 44th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 108th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yuanchun 徐元春 (registered in an official household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard [Jinyiwei 錦衣衛], originally from Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; Supplementary Student at the Shuntian Prefectural School; specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Zhengfu 正夫; first in seniority among brothers; twenty-seven sui, born on the thirtieth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Fu 徐黼 (Vice Magistrate, posthumously honoured as Specially Promoted Grandee of the Thirty-eighth Class, Pillar of the State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Jianji Hall); his grandfather is Xu Jie 徐階 (Specially Promoted Grandee of the Thirty-eighth Class, Pillar of the State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Jianji Hall); his father is Xu Fan 徐璠 (Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices); his mother was née Ji 季氏 (enfeoffed as Child Nurturer, posthumously honoured as Lady of Virtue). Both his father and grandparents are living [?]. His younger brothers are Xu Yuanpu 徐元普 (National University Student), Xu Yuansi 徐元思 (Battalion Commander of the Center Chiliarchy of the Left/Right Guard of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard [衣中所]), Xu Yuanzhe 徐元悊 (Official Student [guansheng 官生]), Xu Yuanying 徐元應 (Official Student), Xu Yuanxian 徐元憲, Xu Yuanxing 徐元性, Xu Yuanxiang 徐元相, Xu Yuanyang 徐元暘, Xu Yuanzhao 徐元昭, Xu Yuanxu 徐元煦, Xu Yuancai 徐元材, Xu Yuanhui 徐元暉, and Xu Yuancai 徐元寀. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 25th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 23rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Guohua 陳國華 (registered in a civilian household of Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; County Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Yaozuo 堯佐; third in seniority among brothers; twenty-five sui, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Bo 陳播 (posthumously honoured as Assistant Surveillance Commissioner); his grandfather was Chen Hou 陳逅 (Vice Surveillance Commissioner); his father was Chen Xian 陳憲; his father's first wife was née Zou 鄒氏; his mother is née Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Yicheng 陳以誠 and Chen Guoxian 陳國賢; his younger brothers are Chen Guozhang 陳國章 and Chen Guoqing 陳國慶. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 21st in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and 214th in the Metropolitan Examination.

蘇希栻〔貫福建泉州府南安縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字于欽，行一，年三十二，十二月初四日生〕。曾祖澄；祖彬；父燦，母陳氏。永感下。弟希直、希益、希增、希稷、希參、希轍。娶歐陽氏。福建鄉試第五十三名，會試第二百二十八名。

容若玉〔貫直隸安慶府懷寧縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字潔夫，行一，年三十五，十月初六日生〕。曾祖濟；祖仁；父恭〔審理副〕，嫡母許氏，生母韓氏。慈侍下。弟若春。娶汪氏，繼娶周氏。應天府鄉試第八十一名，會試第一百十一名。

王錄〔貫山東兖州府東平州壽張縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字子薦，行二，年三十二，九月十九日生〕。曾祖維；祖孜；父謙〔省祭官〕，母崔氏。永感下。兄鈿〔監生〕；弟鈞〔監生〕、鎬、鑰、鎮、鍍。娶閻氏，繼娶陳氏。山東鄉試第十二名，會試第一百五十一名。

王家棟〔貫浙江嘉興府嘉興縣民籍，海鹽縣人，嘉興縣學生，治《易經》，字惟隆，行一，年三十三，二月二十九日生〕。曾祖輔〔刑部主事〕；祖𦶜；父滔，母蔡氏。永感下。娶沈氏，繼娶懷氏。浙江鄉試第一名，會試第七十七名。
translation_en:
Su Xishi 蘇希栻, courtesy name Yuqin 于欽, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month, was registered under a military household in Nan'an County 南安縣, Quanzhou Prefecture 泉州府, Fujian 福建, and was a student in the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Su Cheng 蘇澄, his grandfather was Su Bin 蘇彬, his father was Su Can 蘇燦, and his mother was Lady Chen 陳氏, both parents being deceased. His younger brothers were Su Xizhi 蘇希直, Su Xiyi 蘇希益, Su Xizeng 蘇希增, Su Xiji 蘇希稷, Su Xican 蘇希參, and Su Xizhe 蘇希轍; he married Lady Ouyang 歐陽氏. He placed fifty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rong Ruoyu 容若玉, courtesy name Jiefu 潔夫, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the sixth day of the tenth month, was registered under a civilian household in Huaining County 懷寧縣, Anqing Prefecture 安慶府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), and was a student in the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Rong Ji 容濟; his grandfather was Rong Ren 容仁; his father was Rong Gong 容恭, an Assistant Disciplinary Official (Shenli fu) in a princely establishment; his principal mother was Lady Xu 許氏; and his birth mother was Lady Han 韓氏, with only his mother still living. His younger brother was Rong Ruochun 容若春; he married Lady Wang 汪氏 and remarried Lady Zhou 周氏. He placed eighty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Lu 王錄, courtesy name Zijian 子薦, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month, was registered under a civilian household in Shouzhang County 壽張縣, Dongping Subprefecture 東平州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東, and was a prefectural student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Wang Wei 王維; his grandfather was Wang Zi 王孜; his father was Wang Qian 王謙, a sacrificial attendant official awaiting appointment (Shengji guan); and his mother was Lady Cui 崔氏, both parents being deceased. His elder brother was Wang Dian 王鈿, a Directorate student (Jiansheng), and his younger brothers were Wang Jun 王鈞, a Directorate student, Wang Hao 王鎬, Wang Yao 王鑰, Wang Zhen 王鎮, and Wang Du 王鍍; he married Lady Yan 閻氏 and remarried Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed twelfth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jiadong 王家棟, courtesy name Weilong 惟隆, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the second month, was a native of Haiyan County 海鹽縣 registered under a civilian household in Jiaxing County 嘉興縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江, and was a Jiaxing County student specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Wang Fu 王輔, a Secretary in the Ministry of Justice (Xingbu zhushi); his grandfather was Wang Jue 王𦶜; his father was Wang Tao 王滔; and his mother was Lady Cai 蔡氏, both parents being deceased. He married Lady Shen 沈氏 and remarried Lady Huai 懷氏. He placed first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

馬鳴鑾〔貫四川成都府內江縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字君御，行一，年二十七，正月十五日生〕。曾祖愷；祖升階〔知縣〕；父魯卿〔進士〕；母劉氏；繼母高氏。重慶下。弟鳴錄、鳴鎣、鳴衡、鳴金、鳴轂、鳴鑒、鳴鎏。娶譚氏。四川鄉試第十二名，會試第一百五十四名。

陳邦彥〔貫直隸池州府青陽縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝美，行九，年二十八，正月十一日生〕。曾祖潾；祖頊；父錙；母高氏；繼母王氏。永感下。兄邦憲、邦惇、邦仲、邦畿〔監生〕、邦拱、邦奇、邦訓、邦任〔監生〕。娶曹氏。應天府鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百七十九名。

陶允宜〔貫浙江紹興府會稽縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字懋中，行三十二，年二十五，閏六月十三日生〕。曾祖諧〔兵部左侍郎，贈兵部尚書，諡莊敏，進階資德大夫、正治上卿〕；祖師賢〔鴻臚寺主簿，累贈翰林院編修兼春坊左贊善，再贈翰林院侍讀學士〕；父大臨〔吏部右侍郎兼翰林院侍讀學士，贈禮部尚書，諡文僖〕；母陳氏〔封淑人〕。慈侍下。兄允光〔貢士〕、允淳〔尚寶司司丞〕、允俊〔監生〕、允端、允傑、允濟〔監生〕；弟允嘉、允亮、允彥。娶諸氏。浙江鄉試第五名，會試第八名。

translation_en:
Ma Mingluan 馬鳴鑾 (registered in a civilian household of Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Junyu 君御; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Ma Kai 愷; his grandfather was Ma Shengjie 升階 (District Magistrate); his father is Ma Luqing 魯卿 (metropolitan graduate (jinshi)); his mother was Lady Liu 劉氏, and his stepmother is Lady Gao 高氏. His grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Minglu 鳴錄, Mingying 鳴鎣, Mingheng 鳴衡, Mingjin 鳴金, Minggu 鳴轂, Mingjian 鳴鑒, and Mingliu 鳴鎏. He married Lady Tan 譚氏. He placed twelfth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Bangyan 陳邦彥 (registered in a civilian household of Qingyang County, Chizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Rumei 汝美; ninth in generational seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Chen Lin 潾; his grandfather was Chen Xu 頊; his father was Chen Zi 錙; his mother was Lady Gao 高氏, and his stepmother was Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Bangxian 邦憲, Bangdun 邦惇, Bangzhong 邦仲, Bangji 邦畿 (Student of the Directorate of Education), Banggong 邦拱, Bangqi 邦奇, Bangxun 邦訓, and Bangren 邦任 (Student of the Directorate of Education). He married Lady Cao 曹氏. He placed twenty-first in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tao Yunyi 陶允宜 (registered in a civilian household of Kuaiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Maozhong 懋中; thirty-second in generational seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the thirteenth day of the intercalary sixth month). His great-grandfather was Tao Xie 諧 (Left Vice Minister of War, posthumously promoted to Minister of War, canonized as Zhuangmin 莊敏, and advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Assisting toward Goodness and Upper Senior Official for Rectifying Governance); his grandfather was Tao Shixian 師賢 (Recorder in the Court of State Ceremonial, successively granted the posthumous titles of Junior Compiler in the Hanlin Academy concurrent with Left Admonisher in the Left Secretariat of the Heir Apparent, and Academician Reader-in-Waiting in the Hanlin Academy); his father was Tao Dalin 大臨 (Right Vice Minister of Personnel concurrent with Academician Reader-in-Waiting in the Hanlin Academy, posthumously promoted to Minister of Rites, and canonized as Wenxi 文僖); and his mother is Lady Chen 陳氏 (invested as Mistress of Virtue). His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Yunguang 允光 (Tribute Student (gongshi)), Yunchun 允淳 (Vice Minister of the Seal Office), Yunjun 允俊 (Student of the Directorate of Education), Yunduan 允端, Yunjie 允傑, and Yunji 允濟 (Student of the Directorate of Education); his younger brothers are Yunjia 允嘉, Yunliang 允亮, and Yunyan 允彥. He married Lady Zhu 諸氏. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Shuling 陳述齡 (registered in a military household of Mianyang Subprefecture, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zishou 子壽; first in generational seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Jing 景; his grandfather was Chen Zan 瓚; his father is Chen Wei 偉; and his mother is Lady Fu 傅氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shuzhong 述忠 and Shukui 述夔. He married Lady Jin 金氏. He placed first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

曾祖永中　祖德光　父廷蘭　母戴氏
具慶下　弟一雷　一龍　娶夏氏
福建鄉試第六名　會試第二十四名
===
陳嘉賓
貫河南汝寧府光州商城縣民籍　縣學生
治詩經字天民行三年二十四九月十五日生
曾祖伯友　祖滿　父意　母周氏　繼母宋氏
慈侍下　兄嘉猷　嘉會　娶桂氏　繼娶商氏
河南鄉試第二名　會試第二百二十名
謝詔
貫江西贛州府贛縣軍籍　府學生
治詩經字彥實行一年三十二九月初四日生
曾祖崇忠　祖績　父時濂　前母趙氏　母趙氏
具慶下　弟試　訪　詩　娶蔡氏
江西鄉試第二十七名　會試第一百七十七名
punctuated:
汪應蛟〔貫直隸徽州府婺源縣，民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字蔚翔，行四，年二十五，八月初七日生〕。曾祖存福；祖希利；父煥祖；母江氏，繼母朱氏。具慶下。兄應龍、應儀、應元；弟應方。娶曹氏。應天府鄉試第十九名，會試第一百三十三名。

許一星〔貫福建興化府莆田縣，匠籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字拱辰，行一，年二十六，九月初六日生〕。曾祖永中；祖德光；父廷庸；母戴氏。具慶下。弟一雷、一龍。娶夏氏。福建鄉試第六名，會試第二十四名。

陳嘉賓〔貫河南汝寧府光州商城縣，民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字天民，行三，年二十四，九月十五日生〕。曾祖伯友；祖滿；父意；母周氏，繼母宋氏。慈侍下。兄嘉猷、嘉會。娶桂氏，繼娶尚氏。河南鄉試第二名，會試第二百二十名。

謝詔〔貫江西贛州府贛縣，軍籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字彥實，行一，年三十二，九月初四日生〕。曾祖景忠；祖績；父時濂；前母趙氏，母趙氏。具慶下。弟試、訪、詩。娶蔡氏。江西鄉試第二十七名，會試第一百七十七名。
translation_en:
Wang Yingjiao 汪應蛟 (native of Wuyuan County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili; civilian household registration; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Weixiang 蔚翔; fourth in generational order; age twenty-five; born on the seventh day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Cunfu 存福; his grandfather was Wang Xili 希利; his father is Wang Huanzu 煥祖; his mother was née Jiang 江氏, and his stepmother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Yinglong 應龍, Wang Yingyi 應儀, and Wang Yingyuan 應元; his younger brother is Wang Yingfang 應方. He married née Cao 曹氏. He placed 19th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 133rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yixing 許一星 (native of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; artisan household registration; Supernumerary County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Gongchen 拱辰; first in generational order; age twenty-six; born on the sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yongzhong 永中; his grandfather was Xu Deguang 德光; his father is Xu Tingyong 廷庸; his mother is née Dai 戴氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Yilei 一雷 and Xu Yilong 一龍. He married née Xia 夏氏. He placed 6th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 24th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Jiabin 陳嘉賓 (native of Shangcheng County, Guangzhou Department, Runing Prefecture, Henan; civilian household registration; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tianmin 天民; third in generational order; age twenty-four; born on the fifteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Boyou 伯友; his grandfather was Chen Man 滿; his father was Chen Yi 意; his mother was née Zhou 周氏, and his stepmother is née Song 宋氏. His mother is living (his father is deceased). His elder brothers are Chen Jiayou 嘉猷 and Chen Jiahui 嘉會. He married née Gui 桂氏, and took as his second wife née Shang 尚氏. He placed 2nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 220th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Zhao 謝詔 (native of Gan County, Ganzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; military household registration; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yanshi 彥實; first in generational order; age thirty-two; born on the fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Jingzhong 景忠; his grandfather was Xie Ji 績; his father is Xie Shilian 時濂; his father's former wife was née Zhao 趙氏, and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xie Shi 試, Xie Fang 訪, and Xie Shi 詩. He married née Cai 蔡氏. He placed 27th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 177th in the Metropolitan Examination.

劉孟雷貫江西吉安府廬陵縣軍籍　縣學附學生
治易經字靜之行一年三十一九月二十一日生

治書經字克濟行三年二十九七月二十日生
曾祖伯元　祖宗信　父儀　母陳氏　繼母陳氏
具慶下　兄銓　弟經忠　漸　娶胡氏
福建鄉試第五十一名　會試第一百名
punctuated:
張之屏〔貫山西澤州沁水縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字憲夫，行一，年三十一，九月初六日生〕。曾祖璧；祖鎧〔王府教授〕；父知本〔壽官〕；母王氏，繼母霍氏、陳氏。重慶下。兄之藩，弟之綱、之翰、之紀、之樞、之度、之和、之恒、之時、之茂、之盛。娶李氏。山西鄉試第二十名，會試第一百六十八名。

萬文卿〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《書經》，字存良，行二，年二十九，九月二十七日生〕。曾祖曰夔〔知縣〕；祖育德；父應舉；母張氏。具慶下。弟文元、文逵。娶王氏。江西鄉試第八名，會試第一百九名。

劉孟雷〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣軍籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字靜之，行一，年三十一，九月二十一日生〕。曾祖本忠；祖國信〔贈刑部主事〕；父教〔知府〕；母王氏〔封安人〕。嚴侍下。弟孟雨、孟霖。娶張氏。江西鄉試第五十一名，會試第四十七名。

韓濟〔貫福建漳州府龍溪縣匠籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字克濟，行三，年二十九，七月二十日生〕。曾祖伯元；祖宗信；父儀；母陳氏，繼母陳氏。具慶下。兄銓，弟紹忠、漸。娶胡氏。福建鄉試第五十一名，會試第一百名。
translation_en:
Zhang Zhiping 張之屏 (registered under a military household in Qinshui County, Zezhou, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Xianfu 憲夫; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Bi 璧; his grandfather was Zhang Kai 鎧 (Instructor in a Princely Establishment); his father is Zhang Zhiben 知本 (Honorary Elder); his mother was née Wang 王, and his stepmothers were née Huo 霍 and née Chen 陳. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Zhifan 之藩, and his younger brothers are Zhang Zhigang 之綱, Zhang Zhihan 之翰, Zhang Zhiji 之紀, Zhang Zhishu 之樞, Zhang Zhidu 之度, Zhang Zhihe 之和, Zhang Zhiheng 之恒, Zhang Zhishi 之時, Zhang Zhimao 之茂, and Zhang Zhisheng 之盛. He married née Li 李. He placed twentieth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wan Wenqing 萬文卿 (registered under a civilian household in Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Supernumerary Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Cunliang 存良; second in his generation; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wan Yuekui 曰夔 (District Magistrate); his grandfather was Wan Yude 育德; his father is Wan Yingju 應舉; his mother is née Zhang 張. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wan Wenyuan 文元 and Wan Wenkui 文逵. He married née Wang 王. He placed eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Menglei 劉孟雷 (registered under a military household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Supernumerary Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Jingzhi 靜之; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Benzhong 本忠; his grandfather was Liu Guoxin 國信 (posthumously honoured as Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice); his father is Liu Jiao 教 (Prefect); his mother was née Wang 王 (invested as Mistress of Peace). His father is living. His younger brothers are Liu Mengyu 孟雨 and Liu Menglin 孟霖. He married née Zhang 張. He placed fifty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Ji 韓濟 (registered under an artisan household in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Keji 克濟; third in his generation; aged twenty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Han Boyuan 伯元; his grandfather was Han Zongxin 宗信; his father is Han Yi 儀; his mother was née Chen 陳, and his stepmother is née Chen 陳. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Han Quan 銓, and his younger brothers are Han Shaozhong 紹忠 and Han Jian 漸. He married née Hu 胡. He placed fifty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

曾祖昕〔義官〕　祖宙　父庭秀　母黃氏
具慶下　兄有斐有復〔貢士〕有嚴弟有寅有孚有濟　娶王氏　繼娶鄭氏

===
趙以康
貫雲南大理府浪穹縣民籍太和縣人　四川合州學正
治書經字元錫行二年三十三四月初五日生
曾祖茂芳　祖熙　父必魁〔壽官〕　母張氏
慈侍下　兄以安　弟以和　以慶　娶施氏

貫湖廣黃州府蘄水縣弓兵籍　縣學生
治易經字子得行一年三十一九月二十五日生
曾祖玉珊〔恩例冠帶〕　祖文奎〔累封按察司副使〕　父袗〔布政司右布政使〕　母張氏〔累封恭人〕

punctuated:
鄒迪光〔貫直隸常州府無錫縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字彥吉，行二，年二十六，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖鉦〔王府引禮舍人〕；祖子進〔府同知〕；父懋中〔監生〕；母魏氏。嚴侍下。兄謙光、龍光〔貢士〕、近光；弟觀光、鳳光、耿光、道光。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第五十三名，會試第一百四十九名。

洪有聲〔貫福建泉州府南安縣軍籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字懋文，行四，年二十八，二月二十四日生〕。曾祖昕〔義官〕；祖宙；父庭秀；母黃氏。具慶下。兄有斐、有復〔貢士〕、有嚴；弟有寅、有孚、有濟。娶王氏，繼娶鄭氏。福建鄉試第八十六名，會試第一百五十三名。

趙以康〔貫雲南大理府浪穹縣民籍，太和縣人，四川合州學正，治《書經》，字元錫，行二，年三十三，四月初五日生〕。曾祖茂芳；祖熙；父必魁〔壽官〕；母張氏。慈侍下。兄以安；弟以和、以慶。娶施氏。雲南鄉試第三十六名，會試第一百十二名。

朱期至〔貫湖廣黃州府蘄水縣弓兵籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字子得，行一，年三十一，九月二十五日生〕。曾祖玉珊〔恩例冠帶〕；祖文奎〔累封按察司副使〕；父袗〔布政司右布政使〕；母張氏〔累封恭人〕。重慶下。弟期昌、期頤、期萃、期泰、期晉、期豐、期大有、期謙、期豫、期同。娶胡氏。湖廣鄉試第二十六名，會試第二百十九名。
translation_en:
Zou Diguang 鄒迪光 (registered under a military household in Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yanji, second in his generation, aged twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zou Zheng (Usher in a Princely Establishment), his grandfather was Zou Zijin (Prefectural Vice Prefect), his father is Zou Maozhong (National University Student), and his mother was née Wei. His father is living. His elder brothers are Qianguang, Longguang (tribute student [gongshi]), and Jinguang; his younger brothers are Guanguang, Fengguang, Gengguang, and Daoguang. He married Lady Wu. He ranked 53rd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hong Yousheng 洪有聲 (registered under a military household in Nan'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a Supernumerary County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Maowen, fourth in his generation, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Hong Xin (Honorary Official), his grandfather was Hong Zhou, his father is Hong Tingxiu, and his mother is née Huang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Youfei, Youfu (tribute student [gongshi]), and Youyan; his younger brothers are Youyin, Youfu, and Youji. He married Lady Wang, and took Lady Zheng as his second wife. He ranked 86th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Yikang 趙以康 (registered under a commoner household in Langqiong County, Dali Prefecture, Yunnan, originally from Taihe County; a Subprefectural Director of Studies of Hezhou in Sichuan specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yuanxi, second in his generation, aged thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the fourth month). His elder brother is Yi'an; his younger brothers are Yihe and Yiqing. He married Lady Shi. He ranked 36th in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 112th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Qizhi 朱期至 (registered under an archer household in Qishui County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zide, first in his generation, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). He ranked 26th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 219th in the Metropolitan Examination.

孫星〔貫浙江杭州府海寧縣，民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字少陽，行一，年四十三，八月二十八日生〕。曾祖綸，祖勝，父通〔典史〕，母楊氏。永感下。娶周氏。浙江鄉試第六十六名，會試第二十名。
周宗禮〔貫廣東潮州府澄海縣，民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子仁，行四，年三十三，八月十九日生〕。曾祖澣，祖峯，父世玉〔壽官〕，母盧氏，繼母王氏。具慶下。兄道傳、宗道〔恩貢生〕、宗義，弟宗璽。娶鄭氏。廣東鄉試第七名，會試第一百二十七名。
黃凝道〔貫河南南陽府鄧州，民籍，江西南昌縣人，州學生，治《易經》，字懋德，行二，年三十四，正月二十六日生〕。曾祖必榮，祖演，父大義，母羅氏。永感下。兄明道，弟遵道、進道。娶賀氏。河南鄉試第七十八名，會試第二百七名。
translation_en:
Zhang Yikun 張一坤 (registered in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zijian; sixty-sixth in his generational line; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Yihong (Left Assistant Administration Commissioner), his grandfather was Zhang Jingqi (Prefect), his father was Zhang Yuanchong (Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi), and his mother is Madam Hu (invested as Child Nurturer). His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Yizhong, Yiqian, and Yiqin; he is married to Madam Hu. He placed eighty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Xing 孫星 (registered in Haining County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shaoyang; first in his generational line; aged forty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Lun, his grandfather was Sun Sheng, his father was Sun Tong (Jail Warden), and his mother was Madam Yang. Both of his parents are deceased. He is married to Madam Zhou. He placed sixty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zongli 周宗禮 (registered in Chenghai County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ziren; fourth in his generational line; aged thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Han, his grandfather was Zhou Feng, his father is Zhou Shiyu (Honorary Official for Longevity), his mother was Madam Lu, and his stepmother is Madam Wang. His father and stepmother are both living. His elder brothers are Daochuan, Zongdao (Grace Tribute Student), and Zongyi, and his younger brother is Zongxi; he is married to Madam Zheng. He placed seventh in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Ningdao 黃凝道 (registered in Dengzhou, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan, under civilian household status, originally from Nanchang County, Jiangxi; a Department Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Maode; second in his generational line; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Huang Birong, his grandfather was Huang Yan, his father was Huang Dayi, and his mother was Madam Luo. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Mingdao, and his younger brothers are Zundao and Jindao; he is married to Madam He. He placed seventy-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

張國輔〔貫南京金吾後衛軍籍，直隸蘇州府崑山縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字惟德，行一，年三十二，十二月二十日生〕。曾祖春；祖效；父雷；母劉氏；繼母吳氏。具慶下。弟國勛。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十名，會試第四十名。

張時亨〔貫江西建昌府南城縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字禮卿，行四十一，年三十四，三月二十一日生〕。曾祖頤；祖信；父端；母張氏。嚴侍下。弟時泰〔貢士〕、時顯〔貢士〕、時豫、時康。娶龔氏。江西鄉試第六十一名，會試第一百六十一名。

吳中謙〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字惟柄，行二，年三十一，十月初一日生〕。曾祖璜；祖宗貴；父九韶；母陳氏。嚴侍下。弟中節、中乾、中兆、中恒、中元、從中、時中、建中、述中。娶孔氏。廣東鄉試第二十二名，會試第二百九十三名。
translation_en:
Li Shifang 李時芳 (registered under a military household in Wugong County, Qian Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a county school student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weirong; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Shouyi; his grandfather was Tingmei; his father is Sishu (Honorary Official for Longevity); and his mother is Lady Chang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Shiji, and his younger brothers are Shitong and Shimao. He is married to Lady Huang. He placed twelfth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Guofu 張國輔 (registered under a military household in the Nanjing Rear Imperial Bodyguard, originally from Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; a Directorate of Education student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weide; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Chun; his grandfather was Xiao; his father is Lei; his mother was Lady Liu; and his stepmother is Lady Wu. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Guoxun. He is married to Lady Wang. He placed one hundred and thirtieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shiheng 張時亨 (registered under a military household in Nancheng County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; an added student of the county school specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Liqing; forty-first in seniority among his male cousins; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-first day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Yi; his grandfather was Xin; his father is Duan; and his mother was Lady Zhang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Shitai (Tribute Student), Shixian (Tribute Student), Shiyu, and Shikang. He is married to Lady Gong. He placed sixty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhongqian 吳中謙 (registered under a civilian household in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a supplementary student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weibing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the first day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Huang; his grandfather was Zonggui; his father is Jiushao; and his mother was Lady Chen. His father is living. His younger brothers are Zhongjie, Zhongqian, Zhongzhao, Zhongheng, Zhongyuan, Congzhong, Shizhong, Jianzhong, and Shuzhong. He is married to Lady Kong. He placed twenty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred and ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Lin Qiaonan 林喬楠 (registered in a civilian household of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Caida 材逹; second in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Dejun 德峻; his grandfather was Lin He 河; his father is Lin Bocheng 伯成 (Battalion Record Keeper); his mother was née Ye 葉, and his stepmother is née Fu 傅. His father is living. His younger brothers are Qiaodong 喬棟 and Qiaosong 喬松. He married née Li 李. He placed seventy-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhan Siqian 詹思謙 (registered in a civilian household of Changshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; an Added Student at the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weibing 惟柄; forty-fourth in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhan Ying 英; his grandfather was Zhan Shen 紳 (District Magistrate, posthumously granted the prestige title Gentleman for Literature); his father is Zhan Xuheng 需亨 (Ward Commander); his legal mother is née Jiang 江 (invested as Child Nurturer), and his birth mother is née Zhang 張. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Renkui 任逵, Siyao 思堯 (National University Student), Shangyi 尚義, Xianke 獻可, and Ren 任 (all National University Students), Sitang 思湯, Xiance 獻策 (Tribute Student), and Siyu 思虞 (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Siyin 思尹, Siwen 思文, Siwu 思武, and Sixiang 思襄. He married née Jiang 江. He placed seventieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Daochun 王道純 (registered in an official household of the Right Escort Guard of Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a Chang'an County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xiwen 希文; first in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Wang Xiong 雄; his grandfather is Wang Luan 鸞; his father is Wang Zhao 詔; and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He married née Bai 白. He placed eighteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Yi 朱衣 (registered in a military household of Minzhou Guard under the Shaanxi Regional Military Commission; a Guard School Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhangfu 章夫; third in his generation; aged thirty-four, born on the ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Lian 璉; his grandfather was Zhu Jin 錦; his father was Zhu Tingchen 廷臣 (Assistant Magistrate); his father's first wife was née Liu 劉, and his mother was née Zhang 張. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Guan 冠 and Mian 冕. He married née Zhao 趙. He placed forty-fifth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yang Yizhong 楊以忠 [registered in a commoner household in Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; an Expectant Student (zengguang sheng 增廣生) of the County Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Xianqing 顯卿; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one sui, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Luo 楊濼; his grandfather was Yang Jing 楊經 [Superior Medical Officer (yixue zhengke 醫學正科)]; his father is Yang Cheng 楊誠 [Government Student with Honorary Cap and Belt (guandai shengyuan 冠帶生員)]; and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yang Yijing 楊以敬, Yang Yide 楊以德, Yang Yili 楊以禮, and Yang Yiren 楊以仁. He married née Ye 葉氏. He ranked 140th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 160th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Liangzhu 李良柱 [registered in a commoner household in Panyu County 番禺縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東, originally from Dayu County 大庾縣, Jiangxi 江西; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozi sheng 國子生); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Boren 伯任; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six sui, born on the eighth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zongrong 李宗榮; his grandfather was Li Xian 李賢 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan 壽官), posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue (hubu zhushi 戶部主事) and further honored as Grand Master exemplar (zhongxian dafu 中憲大夫)]; his father was Li Luan 李鸞 [Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue (hubu langzhong 戶部郎中)]; and his mother was née Lu 盧氏 [invested as Mistress of Peace (anren 安人)]. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Li Liangdong 李良棟, Li Liangcai 李良材, Li Liangji 李良楫, Li Liangxiang 李良相, Li Liangzhen 李良楨, Li Lianggan 李良榦, and Li Liangkai 李良楷. He married née Peng 彭氏. He ranked 34th in the Guangdong 廣東 Provincial Examination and 54th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Sancai 李三才 [registered in a military household of the Right Wugong Guard 武功右衛, originally from Lintong County 臨潼縣, Shaanxi 陝西; a Supernumerary Student (fuxue sheng 附學生) of the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Daofu 道夫; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one sui, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Duan 李端; his grandfather was Li Lu 李祿; his father is Li Xun 李珣; and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Sanxing 李三省 and Li Sanjie 李三接. He is betrothed to née Ren 任氏. He ranked 102nd in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Third Class, 226 candidates, conferred the status of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen).

Chen Pu 陳朴 (registered under a hereditary military officer household in the Chenzhou Guard, Henan; a student of the Chenzhou Subprefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yichu, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Jian (Battalion Commander [qianhu]); his grandfather was Chen Duan (Battalion Commander); his father was Chen Ang (Battalion Commander); his legal mother is Lady An (invested as Lady of Suitability [yiren]); and his birth mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Kai (Battalion Commander) and Chen Xi, and his younger brother is Chen Shu. He is married to Lady Zhou. He ranked 40th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lei Shizhen 雷士楨 (registered under a military household in Chaoyi County, Tongzhou Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; an added student [fuxuesheng] of the county school specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Guozhu, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Lei Jingrui; his grandfather was Lei Ni; his father was Lei Shiji; and his mother is Lady Han. His mother is living. His elder brother is Lei Shihui. He is married to Lady Han. He ranked 50th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 166th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Su 顏素 (registered under a military household in Huaining County, Anqing Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; an expectant student [zengguangsheng] of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zhiqing, first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Yan Cong; his grandfather was Yan Wei; his father is Yan Xun (Tribute Student [gongshi]); and his mother is Lady Wang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yan Xiu (Sacrificial Attendant [xingjiguan]) and Yan Qi, and his younger brothers are Yan Si, Yan Shu (Sacrificial Attendant), Yan Jiong, Yan Xiang, Yan Chou, and Yan Zhen. He is married to Lady Ma. He ranked 76th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 63rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

牛惟炳〔貫直隸廣平府曲周縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字懋華，行一，年三十三，正月十七日生〕。曾祖紳；祖璽〔封知縣〕；父山木〔按察司僉事，進階朝列大夫〕；母方氏〔贈孺人〕；繼母劉氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下。弟惟煌、燿、煥、烇、爌、燦、熠、煜、煝、焜、烶。娶袁氏，繼娶田氏。順天府鄉試第十七名，會試第四十二名。

translation_en:
Niu Weibing 牛惟炳 [registered in a civilian household of Quzhou County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maohua, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the seventeenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Niu Shen 紳; his grandfather was Niu Xi 璽 [invested as District Magistrate]; his father was Niu Shanmu 山木 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master for Court Service]; his mother was Lady Fang 方氏 [posthumously invested as Child Nurturess]; and his stepmother is Lady Liu 劉氏 [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Weihuang 惟煌, Yao 燿, Huan 煥, Quan 烇, Kuang 爌, Can 燦, Yi 熠, Yu 煜, Mei 煝, Kun 焜, and Ting 烶. He married Lady Yuan 袁氏, and subsequently married Lady Tian 田氏. He placed seventeenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yi Yixun 易以巽 [registered in a military household of An County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Ruzhong, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the fifth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Yi Gang 綱; his grandfather was Yi Daming 大名; his father was Yi Shu 書 [Instructor]; his father's former wives were Lady Zhang 張氏 and Lady Yu 余氏; and his mother is Lady Cao 曹氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yigong 以恭, Yijian 以儉, Yijing 以敬, and Yiqian 以謙; his younger brother is Yijie 以節. He married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Xun 孫旬 [registered in a military household of Laiyang County, Dengzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruomu, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the third day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Hui 惠; his grandfather was Sun Jie 節; his father was Sun Shaoxian 紹先 [District Magistrate]; and his mother is Lady Dai 戴氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Xun 旬 [?; probably a graphic error for a related character, Chief Steward of the Imperial Academy of Medicine]; his younger brothers are Ju 句, Yun 勻, Gou 勾, Dian 甸, and Wu 勿. He married Lady Li 李氏, and subsequently married Lady Ge 葛氏 and Lady Wang 王氏. He placed fifty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Sizhi 楊四知 [registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, originally from Poyang County, Jiangxi; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanshu, first in seniority in his branch, aged thirty-nine, born on the ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Jun 濬 [Princely Physician, posthumously invested as Left Administrator]; his grandfather was Yang Qi 棨 [Princely Physician, posthumously invested as District Magistrate]; his father was Yang Dongshan 東山 [District Magistrate]; and his mother is Lady Zhang 張氏 [invested as Child Nurturess]. His mother is living. His elder brothers (or cousins) are Shiyu 時譽 [Tribute Student], Shining 時寧 [Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel], Shixing 時馨 [metropolitan graduate of the same examination], Xu 續, and Jin 進; his younger brother (or cousin) is Shiyong 時雍. He married Lady Lu 盧氏. He placed thirtieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

蘇雨〔貫四川重慶府巴縣民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字以時，行三，年三十二，五月初九日生〕。曾祖致中〔知府〕；祖廷俸；父夢熊；母李氏，繼母鄭氏。永感下。兄溥〔訓導〕、愽〔恩例冠帶〕；弟進〔監生〕、逵、達、遠。娶蹇氏，繼娶姜氏。四川鄉試第三十六名，會試第一百六十七名。

曹一夔〔貫湖廣寶慶府武岡州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字子韶，行一，年三十三，十一月初三日生〕。曾祖遜〔壽官〕；祖珊；父朝陽；母蔣氏。具慶下。弟一龍。娶張氏。湖廣鄉試第二十八名，會試第一百九十四名。

王問卿〔貫直隸常州府無錫縣民籍，長洲縣人，無錫縣學附學生，治《易經》，字以正，行七，年二十八，七月二十三日生〕。曾祖珩；祖纓；父津；母徐氏。具慶下。兄祖福、祖德、祖齡、朮、本、栢；弟棟。娶惠氏。應天府鄉試第五十四名，會試第二百十三名。

范世美〔貫江西瑞州府高安縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字敬之，行一，年二十七，十月二十四日生〕。曾祖日揥；祖豪〔贈刑部主事〕；父伋〔刑部主事〕；前母高氏〔贈安人〕，母王氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。弟世善、世義、世羑。娶傅氏。江西鄉試第二十六名，會試第一百三十七名。
translation_en:
Su Yu 蘇雨 (registered as a civilian household in Ba County 巴縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yishi 以時; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the ninth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Su Zhizhong 蘇致中 (Prefect), his grandfather was Su Tingfeng 蘇廷俸, his father was Su Mengxiong 蘇夢熊, his mother was Lady Li 李氏, and his stepmother was Lady Zheng 鄭氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Su Pu 蘇溥 (Assistant Instructor) and Su Bo 蘇愽 (granted cap and belt by grace precedent); his younger brothers are Su Jin 蘇進 (Student of the Directorate of Education), Su Kui 蘇逵, Su Da 蘇達, and Su Yuan 蘇遠. He married Lady Jian 蹇氏, and remarried Lady Jiang 姜氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Yikui 曹一夔 (registered as a civilian household in Wugang Subprefecture 武岡州, Baoqing Prefecture 寶慶府, Huguang 湖廣; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Zishao 子韶; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Cao Xun 曹遜 (Honorary Official for Longevity), his grandfather was Cao Shan 曹珊, his father is Cao Chaoyang 曹朝陽, and his mother is Lady Jiang 蔣氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Cao Yilong 曹一龍. He married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed twenty-eighth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Wenqing 王問卿 (registered as a civilian household in Wuxi County 無錫縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, originally from Changzhou County 長洲縣; a Supernumerary Student of the Wuxi County School specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yizheng 以正; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Heng 王珩, his grandfather was Wang Ying 王纓, his father is Wang Jin 王津, and his mother is Lady Xu 徐氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Zufu 王祖福, Wang Zude 王祖德, Wang Zuling 王祖齡, Wang Zhu 王朮, Wang Ben 王本, and Wang Bai 王栢; his younger brother is Wang Dong 王棟. He married Lady Hui 惠氏. He placed fifty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Shimei 范世美 (registered as a civilian household in Gao'an County 高安縣, Ruizhou Prefecture 瑞州府, Jiangxi 江西; a Supernumerary Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Jingzhi 敬之; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Fan Riti 范日揥, his grandfather was Fan Hao 范豪 (posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), his father is Fan Ji 范伋 (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), his father's former wife was Lady Gao 高氏 (posthumously honoured as Lady of Serenity), and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏 (invested as Lady of Serenity). Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Fan Shishan 范世善, Fan Shiyi 范世義, and Fan Shiyou 范世羑. He married Lady Fu 傅氏. He placed twenty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Huang Shiyu 黃時雨 [registered in a civilian household of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Huazhi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Qin 欽, his grandfather was Huang Tang 堂, his father is Huang Zuxiang 祖相, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Huang Tang 堂 [?], and his younger brother is Huang Zhong 重. He married née Gu 顧氏. He placed 119th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 93rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Yunfu 魏允孚 [registered in a civilian household of Nanle County, Daming Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Maocheng; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wei Tai 泰, his grandfather was Wei Jing 經, his father is Wei Yi 怡 [Assistant Prefect], his father's former wife was née Wang 王氏, and his mother was née Yang 楊氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Wei Yunzhen 允貞 and Wei Yunzhong 允中. He married née Zhou 周氏, and remarried née Zhao 趙氏. He placed 38th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 248th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xia Yingxing 夏應星 [registered in a civilian household of Yancheng County, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Changqing; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Xia Hui 惠, his grandfather was Xia Neng 能 [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice], his father was Xia Lei 雷 [Administration Vice Commissioner], his legal mother was née Tang 唐氏 [invested as Master's Wife], and his birth mother is née Fu 傅氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Xia Yingchen 應宸, Xia Yingcai 應寀 [Usher in a Princely Establishment], and Xia Yingzhao 應詔. He married née Hu 胡氏. He placed 25th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 70th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Duojian 李多見 [registered in a civilian household of Xianyou County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, a native of Putian County; a student of the Xianyou County school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zixing; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Weicha 維察, his grandfather is Li Zhongxian 仲獻, his father is Li Deyong 德用 [District Magistrate], and his mother is née Lin 林氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He married née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 84th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 5th in the Metropolitan Examination.

===

曾祖驥〔封刑部郎中〕　祖天爵〔按察司副使〕　父道　母陳氏

王見賓
貫山東濟南衛軍籍　歷城縣學生
治易經字子利行三年三十五九月初二日生
曾祖珍　祖睿　父儒　母楊氏
永感下　兄用召　用畢　娶張氏
