punctuated:
常居敬〔貫湖廣武昌衛軍籍，江夏縣人，武昌府學生，治《詩經》，字汝一，行一，年二十七，十一月二十九日生〕。曾祖慶〔知縣〕；祖繼〔壽官〕；父自省；母王氏。慈侍下。弟居仁、居謙、居美、居安、居和、居易、居中。娶許氏。湖廣鄉試第四十名，會試第一百二十四名。

史元熙〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《禮記》，字良明，行二，年二十，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖本端；祖立模〔知府〕；父自上〔貢士〕；母邵氏。具慶下。兄重淵〔貢士〕、銓〔貢士〕、鈳〔翰林院庶吉士〕、元炁；弟元勳、元杰、元燾。娶胡氏。浙江鄉試第四十四名，會試第二百五十七名。

黃師顏〔貫福建泉州府南安縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字有發，行二，年二十八，八月二十二日生〕。曾祖驥〔封刑部郎中〕；祖天爵〔按察司副使〕；父道；母陳氏。慈侍下。兄必健〔恩例貢生〕、襄〔貢士〕、師尹〔貢士〕、師臯〔貢士〕；弟鳴勳〔官生〕、師曾、師閔、南金。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第三十三名，會試第四十一名。

王見賓〔貫山東濟南衛軍籍，歷城縣學生，治《易經》，字子利，行三，年三十五，九月初二日生〕。曾祖珍；祖睿；父儒；母楊氏。永感下。兄用召、用畢。娶張氏。山東鄉試第十三名，會試第八十六名。
translation_en:
Chang Jujing 常居敬 [registered in a military household of the Wuchang Guard in Huguang, a native of Jiangxia County, a student of the Wuchang Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), courtesy name Ruyi, first in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chang Qing [District Magistrate]; his grandfather was Chang Ji [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father was Chang Zixing; and his mother is née Wang, who is still living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Juren, Juqian, Jumei, Ju'an, Juhe, Juyi, and Juzhong; he is married to née Xu. He placed fortieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Yuanxi 史元熙 [registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County in Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, a supernumerary student of the county school, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), courtesy name Liangming, second in seniority, age twenty, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Benduan; his grandfather was Shi Limo [Prefect]; his father is Shi Zishang [tribute graduate (gongshi)]; and his mother is née Shao, with both parents still living. His elder brothers are Chongyuan [tribute graduate], Quan [tribute graduate], Ke [Hanlin Bachelor], and Yuanqi; his younger brothers are Yuanxun, Yuanjie, and Yuantao; he is married to née Hu. He placed forty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Shiyan 黃師顏 [registered in a civilian household of Nan'an County in Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, a supernumerary student of the county school, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Youfa, second in seniority, age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Ji [granted the title of Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his grandfather was Huang Tianjue [ Surveillance Vice Commissioner]; his father was Huang Dao; and his mother is née Chen, who is still living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Bijian [tribute student by special grace (enli gongsheng)], Xiang [tribute graduate], Shiyin [tribute graduate], and Shigao [tribute graduate]; his younger brothers are Mingxun [student by privilege (guansheng)], Shizeng, Shimin, and Nanjin; he is married to née Wu. He placed thirty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jianbin 王見賓 [registered in a military household of the Jinan Guard in Shandong, a student of the Licheng County School, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Zili, third in seniority, age thirty-five, born on the second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhen; his grandfather was Wang Rui; his father was Wang Ru; and his mother was née Yang, both parents being deceased. His elder brothers are Yongzhao and Yongbi; he is married to née Zhang. He placed thirteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

何鑛〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字子啓，行三，年三十九，七月十一日生〕。曾祖采；祖輝；父墨〔布政司都事〕；前母王氏，母周氏。永感下。兄鉦、鈁〔貢士〕；弟錞〔監生〕、鉉〔監生〕。娶趙氏。應天府鄉試第三十五名，會試第一百八十一名。
馬貫〔貫直隸蘇州府吳江縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字道卿，行二，年三十一，五月十七日生〕。曾祖敬；祖驄；父乾；母汝氏，繼母王氏。嚴侍下。兄賢。娶鈕氏。應天府鄉試第十六名，會試第二百三十名。
沈孟化〔貫福建汀州府永定縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字叔順，行三，年三十四，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖仁綱；祖景厚；父玉章〔縣主簿〕；母林氏。慈侍下。兄孟作、孟似；弟孟伸、孟儀、孟儼、孟脩、孟佐、孟伊。娶鄭氏。福建鄉試第四十二名，會試第一百九十六名。
王炳璿〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字幼文，行二，年三十七，四月初十日生〕。曾祖銀〔贈翰林院編脩〕；祖同祖〔國子監司業兼司經局校書〕；父法〔監生〕；母陸氏。慈侍下。兄〔炳衡，知縣〕；弟〔炳輔、炳𨌆〕、炳陽、炳權、炳樞、炳昻、炳魁、炳斗。娶魏氏。應天府鄉試第十六名，會試第一百二十八名。
translation_en:
He Kuang 何鑛 (native of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Ziqi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the eleventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was He Cai; his grandfather was He Hui; his father was He Mo (Office Manager of a Provincial Administration Commission); his father's former wife was née Wang, and his mother was née Zhou. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are He Zheng and He Fang (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are He Chun (National University Student) and He Xuan (National University Student). He married née Zhao. He placed thirty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Guan 馬貫 (native of Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, of civilian registration; an Added-quota Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Daoqing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Ma Jing; his grandfather was Ma Cong; his father is Ma Qian; his mother was née Ru, and his stepmother is née Wang. His father is living. His elder brother is Ma Xian. He married née Niu. He placed sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Menghua 沈孟化 (native of Yongding County, Tingzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian registration; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shushun; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Rengang; his grandfather was Shen Jinghou; his father was Shen Yuzhang (County Assistant Magistrate); his mother is née Lin. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Shen Mengzuo and Shen Mengsi; his younger brothers are Shen Mengshen, Shen Mengyi, Shen Mengyan, Shen Mengxiu, Shen Mengzuo, and Shen Mengyi. He married née Zheng. He placed forty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Bingxuan 王炳璿 (native of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, of civilian registration; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Youwen; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the tenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yin (posthumously titled Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy); his grandfather was Wang Tongzu (Director of Studies in the Directorate of Education concurrently serving as Proofreader in the Editorial Service); his father was Wang Fa (National University Student); his mother is née Lu. His mother is living. His elder brother is [Wang Bingheng, District Magistrate]; his younger brothers are [Wang Bingfu, Wang Bingheng], Wang Bingyang, Wang Bingquan, Wang Bingshu, Wang Bing'ang, Wang Bingkui, and Wang Bingdou. He married née Wei. He placed sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

賀一孝〔貫河南汝州魯山縣民籍，湖廣酃縣人，魯山縣學生，治《詩經》，字子順，行四，年三十六，五月二十五日生〕。曾祖慶；祖鳳；父宗朝〔教諭〕；母朱氏。慈侍下。兄一卿、一相、一忠。娶劉氏。河南鄉試第七十名，會試第二百七十一名。

鄭皐〔貫四川重慶府忠州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字懋堅，行一，年三十一，八月初五日生〕。曾祖時彥；祖銳；父希僑；母黃氏。慈侍下。弟畢。娶眭氏。四川鄉試第十二名，會試第一百三名。

許鋌〔貫順天府通州武清縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字定之，行三，年二十三，十一月二十八日生〕。曾祖鐸；祖世英；父大紀；母董氏。重慶下。兄鏜、銳、鉞、銘、鎡；弟金、鑛、鐘、錢。娶劉氏。順天府鄉試第十五名，會試第四十八名。

韓志道〔貫山東濟南府章丘縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝立，行一，年三十五，二月二十四日生〕。曾祖濟民；祖孟益〔倉副使〕；父國治；母齊氏。慈侍下。弟學道。娶張氏。山東鄉試第六名，會試第二百五十五名。
translation_en:
He Yixiao 賀一孝 (registered under civilian household status in Lushan County 魯山縣, Ruzhou 汝州, Henan 河南, originally from Ling County 酃縣, Huguang 湖廣; a Lushan County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zishun 子順, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was He Qing 慶; his grandfather was He Feng 鳳; his father was He Zongchao 宗朝 (Instructor); and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yiqing 一卿, Yixiang 一相, and Yizhong 一忠. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed 70th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 271st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Gao 鄭皐 (registered under civilian household status in Zhongzhou 忠州, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maojian 懋堅, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Shiyan 時彥; his grandfather was Zheng Rui 銳; his father was Zheng Xiqiao 希僑; and his mother is née Huang 黃氏. His mother is living. His younger brother is Bi 畢. He married née Sui 眭氏. He placed 12th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 103rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Ting 許鋌 (registered under civilian household status in Wuqing County 武清縣, Tongzhou 通州, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dingzhi 定之, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Xu Duo 鐸; his grandfather is Xu Shiying 世英; his father is Xu Daji 大紀; and his mother is née Dong 董氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Tang 鏜, Rui 銳, Yue 鉞, Ming 銘, and Zi 鎡; his younger brothers are Jin 金, Kuang 鑛, Zhong 鐘, and Qian 錢. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed 15th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 48th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jin 劉金 (registered in a civilian household of Yucheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zinan; first in seniority; age thirty-three, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month). He married née Wang, and remarried née Wang. He placed fortieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 146th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yangchan 陳揚産 (registered in a civilian household of Tongren Prefecture, Guizhou, a native of Fushun County, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Yiqing; fourth in seniority; age twenty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the third month). Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Chuchan (National University Student), Huaichan, and Wuchan (Tribute Student), and his younger brothers are Qianchan, Luchan, Zhouchan, and Xunchan. He married née Zhang. He placed eighth in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and 227th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Zhao 姜召 (registered in a civilian household of Guang'an Subprefecture, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Keshu; third in seniority; age thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yonghe; his grandfather was Congjian (invested as Secretary of a Bureau, successively invested as Prefect); his father was En (Left Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission); his former mother was née Li (posthumously honored as Respectful Lady), and his mother was née Deng (invested as Peaceful Lady). He placed thirty-eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳王庭〔貫浙江杭州府仁和縣匠籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字惟獻，行三，年三十二，正月三十日生〕。曾祖天瑀，祖宿，父震，母曹氏。具慶下。兄王言、王章，弟王宁。娶戴氏。浙江鄉試第六十八名，會試第九十八名。
translation_en:
Chen Jiace 陳嘉策 (registered in a military household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; supernumerary student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuxie; first in his generation; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Xin, his grandfather was Chen Zhipu, his father was Chen Yuan, and his mother is née Feng. His mother is living while his father is deceased. He married née Fu. He placed forty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Fu 沈鈇 (registered in a civilian household in Zhao'an County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; added student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jiyang; fourth in his generation; aged twenty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Shen Heng, his grandfather is Shen Daolong, his father is Shen Xi, and his mother is née Ye. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Shen Kai, Shen Miao, Shen Keying, and Shen Zu; his younger brothers are Shen Kedu, Shen Shou, and Shen Ying. He married née Chen. He placed seventeenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Weng Zhongyi 翁仲益 (registered in a civilian household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and a native of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture; student of the Min County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zande; third in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Weng Qinyuan, his grandfather was Weng Qing, his father is Weng Yaoming, and his mother is née Wei. Both of his parents are living. He married née Cai. He placed fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Wangting 陳王庭 (registered in an artisan household in Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weixian; third in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the thirtieth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Chen Tianyu, his grandfather was Chen Su, his father is Chen Zhen, and his mother is née Cao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Wangyan and Chen Wangzhang; his younger brother is Chen Wangzhu. He married née Dai. He placed sixty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
胡希舜〔貫河南開封府原武縣民籍，山西臨晉縣人。國子生，治《詩經》，字惟善，行一，年二十五，二月初十日生〕。曾祖明，祖淵，父廷瓚〔教諭〕，前母楊氏，母韓氏。慈侍下，兄邦俊，娶楊氏。河南鄉試第二十名，會試第九十五名。

張雲翱〔貫山西平陽府解州安邑縣鹽籍。河東運司學生，治《詩經》，字文升，行一，年二十九，三月十二日生〕。曾祖琢〔恩例冠帶〕，祖訥〔封南京戶部員外郎〕，父良貴〔知縣〕，母馬氏。具慶下，娶賀氏，繼娶李氏。山西鄉試第四十七名，會試第九十一名。

曾夢鰲〔貫福建興化府莆田縣鹽籍。府學生，治《書經》，字君瞻，行三，年三十一，七月初九日生〕。曾祖邦升，祖傳卿，父敬學〔冠帶生員〕，母蔡氏。具慶下，兄夢佳、夢似，弟夢奎、夢吉、夢偕、夢佐，娶丘氏。福建鄉試第二十二名，會試第二百二名。

何允升〔貫河南開封府杞縣匠籍。府學生，治《詩經》，字吉甫，行一，年三十，二月十七日生〕。曾祖景隆，祖立賢〔倉大使〕，父仕〔衛經歷〕，母張氏。重慶下，弟允孚、允中、允治，娶邊氏。河南鄉試第六十一名，會試第二百八名。
translation_en:
Hu Xishun 胡希舜 [registered in a civilian household of Yuanwu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, originally from Linjin County, Shanxi; Student in the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weishan, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-five, born on the tenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Ming, his grandfather was Hu Yuan, and his father was Hu Tingzan [Instructor (Jiaoyu)]; his father's former wife was née Yang, and his mother is née Han. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brother is Bangjun, and he is married to a woman née Yang. He placed twentieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yun'ao 張雲翱 [registered in a saltern household of Anyi County, Xiezhou Department, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Hedong Salt Distribution Commission School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wensheng, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhuo [granted cap and belt by grace (enli guandai)], his grandfather was Zhang Ne [enfeoffed as Vice Director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue (Nanjing Hubu yuanwailang)], his father is Zhang Lianggui [District Magistrate (Zhixian)], and his mother is née Ma. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia). He married a woman née He, and subsequently married a woman née Li. He placed forty-seventh in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Meng'ao 曾夢鰲 [registered in a saltern household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Prefectural Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Junzhan, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zeng Bangsheng, his grandfather was Zeng Chuanqing, his father is Zeng Jingxue [Government Student with Cap and Belt (guandai shengyuan)], and his mother is née Cai. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia). His elder brothers are Mengjia and Mengsi, his younger brothers are Mengkui, Mengji, Mengxie, and Mengzuo, and he is married to a woman née Qiu. He placed twenty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Yunsheng 何允升 [registered in an artisan household of Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; Prefectural Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jifu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the seventeenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was He Jinglong, his grandfather is He Lixian [Granary Commissioner-in-chief (Cang dashi)], his father is He Shi [Guard Registrar (Wei jingli)], and his mother is née Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). His younger brothers are Yunfu, Yunzhong, and Yunzhi, and he is married to a woman née Bian. He placed sixty-first in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

敖選〔貫四川成都府金堂縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字用卿，行一，年二十九，二月十五日生〕。曾祖永吉；祖元；父守愚；母彭氏。慈侍下。娶王氏。四川鄉試第五十一名，會試第一百五十三名。

translation_en:
Lin Mingsheng 林鳴盛: Registered as a civilian household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, he was anAdded Student in the prefectural school specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing), with the courtesy name Yuanhe, third in his generational line, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Yuwan; his grandfather was Xiyan; his father is Yingfei (Government Student with Cap and Belt); and his mother is née Huang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Mingchang and Yuezhang, and his younger brother is Minglei; he married née Zhou. He placed 22nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 55th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Han 于翰: Registered as an artisan household in Jingxing County, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili, he was a Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing), with the courtesy name Sixian, first in his generational line, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was An; his grandfather was Kun; his father is Jinhai (Honorary Official Held in Respect for His Age); his mother was née Zhang; and his stepmother was née Wang. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brother is Qian; he married née Li, and subsequently married née Lu and née Jia. He placed 58th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 254th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ao Xuan 敖選: Registered as a military household in Jintang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, he was an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Yongqing, first in his generational line, aged twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Yongji; his grandfather was Yuan; his father was Shouyu; and his mother is née Peng. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He married née Wang. He placed 51st in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zhengyi 陳正誼: Registered as a military household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Zhili, he was a Student in the prefectural school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Daofu, second in his generational line, aged thirty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Xuan; his grandfather was Han; his father was Ben; and his mother was née Zhu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhengmo, and his younger brothers are Zhengshi and Zhenglun; he married née Chu, and subsequently married née Li. He placed 14th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 68th in the Metropolitan Examination.

永感下 兄乾 弟巽 娶于氏
河南鄉試第三名 會試第二十名
===
郭衢階 貫四川叙州府富順縣民籍 國子生
治春秋字亨甫行三年二十九正月二十四日生
曾祖琛〔七品散官〕 祖宸〔貢士〕 父如一〔冠帶生員〕 母楊氏
重慶下 兄從階 循階 娶杜氏
四川鄉試第四名 會試第二百九十二名
punctuated:
姚德重〔貫山東平度州濰縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字士欽，行一，年二十八，九月十四日生〕。曾祖倫；祖鯤；父英〔壽官〕；母王氏。具慶下。弟德望、德大。娶張氏，繼娶王氏。山東鄉試第七十四名，會試第二百七十四名。

曾士彥〔貫四川瀘州民籍，州學生，治《易經》，字從之，行十三，三正月十三日生〕。曾祖思虎；祖海寬〔封戶部主事〕；父璵〔知府〕；嫡母鄧氏〔封安人〕；生母宋氏。慈侍下。兄士奇、士謀〔貢士〕、士表〔貢士、封兵部員外郎〕、士弘〔貢士〕、士偉〔貢士〕、士崇、士怡、士賢、士林、士朝、士賔；弟士科。娶喻氏。四川鄉試第八名，會試第二百七十四名。

李坤〔貫河南歸德府寧陵縣匠籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字叔簡，行九十四，年三十九，十月初十日生〕。曾祖景；祖慧；父得勝〔壽官〕；前母王氏；母李氏。永感下。兄乾；弟巽。娶于氏。河南鄉試第三名，會試第二十名。

郭衢階〔貫四川叙州府富順縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字亨甫，行三，年二十九，正月二十四日生〕。曾祖瑢〔七品散官〕；祖宸〔貢士〕；父如一〔冠帶生員〕；母楊氏。重慶下。兄從階、循階。娶杜氏。四川鄉試第四名，會試第二百九十二名。
translation_en:
Yao Dezhong 姚德重 (registered in a military household of Wei County 濰縣, Pingdu Subprefecture 平度州, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiqin 士欽; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Lun 倫; his grandfather was Yao Kun 鯤; his father is Yao Ying 英 (Honorary Official for Old Age); and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Dewang 德望 and Deda 德大. He married Lady Zhang 張氏, and took Lady Wang 王氏 as his second wife. He placed seventy-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Shiyan 曾士彥 (registered in a civilian household of Luzhou Subprefecture 瀘州, Sichuan 四川; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Congzhi 從之; thirteenth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty [?], born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zeng Sihu 思虎; his grandfather was Zeng Haikuan 海寬 (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue); his father was Zeng Yu 璵 (Prefect); his legal mother is Lady Deng 鄧氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace); and his birth mother is Lady Song 宋氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Shiqi 士奇, Shimou 士謀 (Tribute Student), Shibiao 士表 (Tribute Student, invested as Vice Director in the Ministry of War), Shihong 士弘 (Tribute Student), Shiwei 士偉 (Tribute Student), Shichong 士崇, Shiyi 士怡, Shixian 士賢, Shilin 士林, Shichao 士朝, and Shibin 士賔; his younger brother is Shike 士科. He married Lady Yu 喻氏. He placed eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Kun 李坤 (registered in an artisan household of Ningling County 寧陵縣, Guide Prefecture 歸德府, Henan 河南; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shujian 叔簡; ninety-fourth in seniority in his generation; aged thirty-nine, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Jing 景; his grandfather was Li Hui 慧; his father was Li Desheng 得勝 (Honorary Official for Old Age); his father's former wife was Lady Wang 王氏; and his mother was Lady Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Qian 乾, and his younger brother is Xun 巽. He married Lady Yu 于氏. He placed third in the Henan Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Qujie 郭衢階 (registered in a civilian household of Fushun County 富順縣, Xuzhou Prefecture 叙州府, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Hengfu 亨甫; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Guo Rong 瑢 (Prestige-title Official of the Seventh Rank); his grandfather is Guo Chen 宸 (Tribute Student); his father is Guo Ruyi 如一 (Government Student with Cap and Belt); and his mother is Lady Yang 楊氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Congjie 從階 and Xunjie 循階. He married Lady Du 杜氏. He placed fourth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
李際春〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，陝西涇陽縣人，府學附學生，治《詩經》，字華卿，行一，年三十二，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖燮；祖瑄；父鯁；母謝氏。永感下。娶謝氏，繼娶方氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十六名，會試第二百八十二名。

劉三宅〔貫山東青州府壽光縣官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字可任，行四，年三十，四月二十八日生〕。曾祖鈁〔知府，進階中憲大夫〕；祖澄甫〔布政司參議〕；父士雲〔監生〕；母藍氏。永感下。兄三德、三俊、三禮。娶丁氏。山東鄉試第四十二名，會試第二百二十五名。

查偉〔貫雲南大理衛軍籍，直隸安慶府懷寧縣人，鶴慶府學生，治《禮記》，字德充，行一，年三十四，八月二十七日生〕。曾祖茂林；祖通庠；父大聘〔監生〕；母吳氏。嚴侍下。弟侁、倜、儁、倫。娶余氏。雲南鄉試第三名，會試第十七名。

蔡時鼎〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣軍籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字台甫，行二，年二十四，十一月十二日生〕。曾祖慈明；祖孟成；父華寵；母鄭氏。重慶下。兄時復；弟時偕、時賁、時達、時熈。娶楊氏。福建鄉試第二十三名，會試第九名。
translation_en:
Li Jichun 李際春 (registered in a commoner household of Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area, originally from Jingyang County, Shaanxi; a supernumerary student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Huaqing; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Xie; his grandfather was Li Xuan; his father was Li Geng; and his mother was née Xie. Both of his parents are deceased. He married née Xie, and subsequently married née Fang. He ranked 136th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 282nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Sanzhai 劉三宅 (registered in an official household of Shouguang County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Keren; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Fang (Prefect, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master exemplar); his grandfather was Liu Chengfu (Assistant Administration Commissioner); his father was Liu Shiyun (Student of the Directorate of Education); and his mother was née Lan. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Liu Sande, Liu Sanjun, and Liu Sanli. He married née Ding. He ranked 42nd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 225th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zha Wei 查偉 (registered in a military household of Dali Guard, Yunnan, originally from Huaining County, Anqing Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; a student of the Heqing Prefectural School; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Dechong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zha Maolin; his grandfather was Zha Tongxiang; his father is Zha Daping (Student of the Directorate of Education); and his mother was née Wu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Zha Shen, Zha Ti, Zha Jun, and Zha Lun. He married née Yu. He ranked 3rd in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 17th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Shiding 蔡時鼎 (registered in a military household of Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a supernumerary student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Taifu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Cai Ciming; his grandfather is Cai Mengcheng; his father is Cai Huachong; and his mother is née Zheng. Both his parents and his grandparents are living. His elder brother is Cai Shifu, and his younger brothers are Cai Shixie, Cai Shibi, Cai Shida, and Cai Shixi. He married née Yang. He ranked 23rd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 9th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
林兆珂〔貫福建興化府莆田縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字懋忠，行一，年二十七，正月二十九日生〕。曾祖垠〔贈通議大夫、兵部右侍郎兼都察院右僉都御史〕；祖富〔通議大夫、兵部右侍郎兼都察院右僉都御史〕；父萬言；母黃氏。重慶下。弟兆珩、兆琦、兆珫。娶鄭氏。福建鄉試第四十六名，會試第一百二十六名。

李承志〔貫山西平陽府曲沃縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字道甫，行十五，年二十八，七月二十三日生〕。曾祖禎〔縣丞，贈兵部侍郎〕；祖浩〔太子少保、禮部尚書，贈太子太保，諡莊簡〕；父鈞〔左長史，進階中順大夫〕；前母張氏〔贈安人〕；母呂氏〔封安人〕。慈侍下。兄承緒〔俱義官〕、承業〔知府〕、承慶〔光祿寺署丞〕、承德〔貢士〕、承恩〔俱監生〕、承寵〔太僕寺少卿〕、承芳〔俱鴻臚寺署丞〕、承賜、承寵、承貺、承儒、承賴、承數。娶裴氏，繼娶吉氏。山西鄉試第五十五名，會試第二百九十七名。

楊時馨〔貫河南開封府祥符縣民籍，江西鄱陽縣人，祥符縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字維德，行三，年三十五，七月初九日生〕。曾祖濬〔良醫，贈左長史〕；祖棨〔良醫，贈知縣〕；父西山〔儀賓，封奉訓大夫〕；母封餘姚縣君。具慶下。兄時譽〔貢士〕、時寧〔吏部主事〕、續進；弟四知〔同科進士〕、時雍。娶陸氏。河南鄉試第七十七名，會試第二百八十名。

陳諫〔貫陝西西安府華州華陰縣匠籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字直卿，行二，年三十七，正月初一日生〕。曾祖玘；祖翺；父邦佑〔典史〕；母師氏。永感下。兄鵷、鶴、鶚、鵬、鶤、鴻。娶石氏。陝西鄉試第三十二名，會試第二百六十一名。
translation_en:
Lin Zhaoke 林兆珂 (registered under a military household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Maozhong, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Lin Yin (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel, Right Vice Minister of War and concurrently Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate); his grandfather was Lin Fu (Grand Master for Thorough Counsel, Right Vice Minister of War and concurrently Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate); his father is Lin Wanyan; his mother is Lady Huang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhaamo/Zhaoheng, Zhaoqi, and Zhaochong. He married Lady Zheng. He placed 46th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Chengzhi 李承志 (registered under a military household in Quwo County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; an Added Student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Daofu, fifteenth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Li Zhen (Assistant Magistrate, posthumously honoured as Vice Minister of War); his grandfather was Li Hao (Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of Rites, posthumously honoured as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Zhuangjian); his father was Li Jun (Left Administrator of a Princely Establishment, advanced in prestige title to Grand Master of the Palace for Accord); his father's first wife was Lady Zhang (posthumously honoured as Mistress of Peace); his mother is Lady Lü (invested as Mistress of Peace). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chengxu (both [?] Righteous Officials), Chengye (Prefect), Chengqing (Assistant Director of an Office in the Court of Imperial Entertainments), Chengde (Tribute Student), Cheng'en (both [?] National University Students), Chengchong (Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud), Chengfang (both [?] Assistant Directors of an Office in the Court of State Ceremonial), Chengci, Chengchong [sic], Chengkuang, Chengru, Chenglai, and Chengshu. He married Lady Pei, and subsequently married Lady Ji. He placed 55th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 297th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Shixing 楊時馨 (registered under a civilian household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, originally from Boyang County, Jiangxi; an Added Student of the Xiangfu county school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weide, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Jun (Physician of a Princely Establishment, posthumously honoured as Left Administrator); his grandfather was Yang Qi (Physician of a Princely Establishment, posthumously honoured as District Magistrate); his father is Yang Xishan (Imperial Clan Consort, invested as Grand Master for Rendering Advice); his mother is invested as District Mistress of Yuyao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shiyu (Tribute Student), Shining (Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel), and Xujin; his younger brothers are Sizhi (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class) and Shiyong. He married Lady Lu. He placed 77th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 280th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Jian 陳諫 (registered under an artisan household in Huayin County, Hua Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhiqing, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-seven, born on the first day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Chen Qi; his grandfather was Chen Ao; his father was Chen Bangyou (Jail Warden); his mother was Lady Shi. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yuan, He, E, Peng, Kun, and Hong. He married Lady Shi. He placed 32nd in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 261st in the Metropolitan Examination.

王儒〔貫山西太原府平定州守禦千戶所軍籍，州學附學生，治《春秋》，字汝為，行二，年三十二，十一月初九日生〕。曾祖安，祖邦柱，父雲鵬，母霍氏。慈侍下。兄儔，弟价、偉、仕、僎、侃、佳、伋。娶白氏。山西鄉試第五名，會試第六十九名。

何鳳起〔貫湖廣黃州府蘄水縣軍籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字文興，行六，年三十四，六月十八日生〕。曾祖希呂，祖仲玄，父大昭，母王氏，繼母周氏。具慶下。兄鳳池、鳳岡、鳳詔、鳳毛、鳳陪，弟清、侣、伊、作。娶陳氏。湖廣鄉試第六十一名，會試第九十名。

倪三綬〔貫直隸河間府阜城縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字守秩，行二，年二十六，十二月十八日生〕。曾祖談，祖厚〔監生〕，父雲鵬〔知州〕，母王氏。慈侍下。兄三章〔貢士〕，弟三善。娶李氏。順天府鄉試第十八名，會試第一百四十名。
translation_en:
Gu Lianbi 顧連璧 [registered under military status in Boxing County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuewen, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the third day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Yu [Assistant Magistrate], his grandfather was Gu Yan [Honorary Official], his father was Gu Cunren [Prefectural Record Keeper], and his mother was née Li. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Gu Hebi [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Gu Lianzhu, Gu Hezhu, Gu Guanzhu [National University Student (jiansheng)], and Gu Longzhu. He married née Song. He placed ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ru 王儒 [registered under military status in the Independent Battalion of Pingding Subprefecture, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; a supernumerary student (fuxuesheng) of the subprefectural school, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Ruwei, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang An, his grandfather was Wang Bangzhu, his father was Wang Yunpeng, and his mother is née Huo. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brother is Wang Chou, and his younger brothers are Wang Jie, Wang Wei, Wang Shi, Wang Zhuan, Wang Kan, Wang Jia, and Wang Ji. He married née Bai. He placed fifth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and sixty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Fengqi 何鳳起 [registered under military status in Qishui County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a county school student, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenxing, sixth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was He Xilü, his grandfather was He Zhongxuan, his father is He Dazhao, his mother was née Wang, and his stepmother is née Zhou. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are He Fengchi, He Fenggang, He Fengzhao, He Fengmao, and He Fengpei, and his younger brothers are He Qing, He Lü, He Yi, and He Zuo. He married née Chen. He placed sixty-first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ni Sanshou 倪三綬 [registered under military status in Fucheng County, Hejian Prefecture, Southern/Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a county school student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shouzhi, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ni Tan, his grandfather was Ni Hou [National University Student (jiansheng)], his father was Ni Yunpeng [Subprefectural Magistrate], and his mother is née Wang. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brother is Ni Sanzhang [Tribute Student (gongshi)], and his younger brother is Ni Sanshan. He married née Li. He placed eighteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Ren Jiadi 任甲第 (registered in a civilian household of Ziyang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zijian; second in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Chongtai, his grandfather was Shen, his father is Guangqi, and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Jiadeng. He is married to née Ding. He placed 66th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 38th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gong Yiqing 龔一清 (registered in a civilian household of Yiwu County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhonghe; second in his generation; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Tong, his grandfather was Long, his father is Guo, and his mother is née Yu. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Yiyuan, Yihao, Yihan, Yicheng, and Yichun. He is married to née Xie. He placed 36th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 122nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Guozhen 韓國楨 (registered in a civilian household of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], a native of Wu County; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhufu; second in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Tai, his grandfather was Gang, his father was Zhang, and his mother is née Jiang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Qin. He is married to née Chen. He placed 105th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 10th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Wanye 宋萬葉 (registered in a military household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Qishao; second in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was He, his grandfather was Li, his father is Xuan (a tribute student / metropolitan examination graduate [gongshi]), and his mother was née Wu. His father is living. His elder brother is Wanyou, and his younger brother is Wanhu. He is married to née Zhang. He placed 9th in the [two illegible characters, Fujian?] Provincial Examination and 115th in the Metropolitan Examination.

毛在〔貫直隸蘇州府太倉州匠籍，州學生，治《易經》，字君明，行二，年三十，十二月十八日生〕。曾祖淵〔恩例冠帶〕；祖希秉；父與存，母李氏。具慶下。兄璧；弟光祚、莊、垠、坤、圻。娶陶氏。應天府鄉試第十四名，會試第一百三十名。

translation_en:
Mao Zai 毛在 (registered under an artisan household in Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a subprefectural student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; style name Junming, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Mao Yuan (granted cap and belt by special grace); his grandfather was Mao Xibing; his father is Mao Yucun, and his mother is Lady Li. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Mao Bi, and his younger brothers are Mao Guangzuo, Mao Zhuang, Mao Yin, Mao Kun, and Mao Qi. He married Lady Tao. He ranked 14th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhongchuan 吳中傳 (registered under a military household in Chaocheng County, Puzhou Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a county student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; style name Ruhe, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Yuan; his grandfather is Wu Long; his father is Wu Laipin (formerly a Messenger, with the added title of Secretary in the Ministry of Rites), his mother was Lady Zhang (posthumously titled Lady of Serenity), and his stepmother is Lady Huang. Both his grandfather and parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Xingchuan, Wu Daochuan (tribute student [gongshi]), and Wu Jiaochuan (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner), and his younger brother is Wu Xinchuan. He married Lady Niu, and remarried Lady Guo. He ranked 42nd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 221st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Junshi 楊俊士 (registered under an official household in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, a native of Puzhou Subprefecture, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; style name Boxian, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Xuan (successively posthumously titled Grand Preceptor of Imperial Entertainments, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel); his grandfather was Yang Zhan (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, enfeoffed as Left Vice Minister of War, and successively posthumously titled Grand Preceptor of Imperial Entertainments, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel); his father is Yang Bo (Grand Preceptor of Imperial Entertainments, Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel), and his mother is Lady Duan (successively enfeoffed as Lady of the First Rank). Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Yang Junmin (Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud), and his younger brothers are Yang Junyan (official student [guansheng]), Yang Junqing (Acting Assistant Military Commissioner administering the affairs of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard), Yang Junchen (official student), and Yang Junjie. He married Lady Pei, and remarried Lady Pei. He ranked 13th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 281st in the Metropolitan Examination.

You Pu 游朴 (registered under a civilian household in Funing Subprefecture, Fujian; a subprefectural student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; style name Taichu, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the first day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was You Yijing; his grandfather was You Xun; his father was You De, and his mother was Lady Chen. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is You Dashao. He married Lady Gao. He ranked 84th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 272nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:

His great-grandfather was Chen Huang, his grandfather was Chen Jing, his father was Chen Zhongjian, and his mother was née Yan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yuyan and Yuli; his younger brothers are Yuwen, Yuxiang [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Yuhou, and Yubo. He married née Zhu. He placed sixty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhenchen 留震臣 [registered in a civilian household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Longde; fifth in generational order; age twenty-seven, born on the seventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Fang [Assistant Prefect, enfeoffed as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Secretary in the Ministry of Justice]; his grandfather was Liu Zhishu [Right Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission]; his father was Liu Yuanfu [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his legal mother was née Yan, and his birth mother is née Cai. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Weiye, Weizhi, Jianchen [National University Student (jiansheng)], and Jingchen [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his younger brothers are Jinchen, Weixiang, Weisen, Weibin, and Weishu. He married née Xu. He placed forty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Guobing 蔡國炳 [registered in a civilian household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Supernumerary Prefectural Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Chengzhong; sixth in generational order; age twenty-eight, born on the fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Cong [honorary official for longevity]; his grandfather was Cai Gui [posthumously granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father is Cai Yigui, and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Guodeng. He married née Li. He placed fiftieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Xisi 譚希思 [registered in a military household in Chaling Subprefecture, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; Subprefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zicheng; seventh in generational order; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Yuhu; his grandfather was Tan Guangsu; his father is Tan Zeqian [Licentiate with Cap and Belt], and his mother is née Li. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiyu, Xiwang, Xidan, Xiyi, Xihui, and Xican; his younger brothers are Xiwei, Xichun, and Xifu. He married née Zhu. He placed sixty-sixth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Nan Xianzhong 南憲仲 [registered in a military household in Weinan County 渭南縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; an Added Student of the County School; specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zizhang 子章; second in his generation; age thirty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Nan Jin 金 [County Director of Studies, posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue]; his grandfather was Nan Fengji 逢吉 [Education-intendant Surveillance Vice Commissioner]; his father is Nan Xuan 軒 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his mother is Lady Pei 裴氏 [invested as Mistress of Peace]. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Nan Xuezhong 學仲 [tribute student (gongshi)]; his younger brothers are Nan Shizhong 師仲, Nan Yangzhong 仰仲, and Nan Qizhong 企仲. He married Lady Zuo 左氏, and subsequently married Lady Niu 牛氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gong Xijue 龔錫爵 [registered in a civilian household in Jiading County 嘉定縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a Supernumerary Student of the County School; specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ruxiu 汝脩; first in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the second day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gong Zheng 正 [National University Student]; his grandfather was Gong Shimei 世美 [National University Student]; his father was Gong Kexue 可學; his mother was Lady Liu 劉氏. Both his parents are deceased. He married Lady Ge 葛氏. He placed eighty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Hui 田蕙 [registered in a civilian household in Ying Subprefecture 應州, Datong Prefecture 大同府, Shanxi 山西; a Student in the Directorate of Education; specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yingfang 應芳; third in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Tian Sheng 盛 [Left Assistant Director of the Imperial Parks Directorate]; his grandfather was Tian Tianze 天澤 [Subprefectural Magistrate]; his father was Tian Weilu 維魯 [Annual Tribute Student]; his mother was Lady Yu 俞氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Tian Lan 蘭 and Tian Qin 芹. He married Lady Qin 秦氏, and subsequently married Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed thirteenth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Lu 馮露 [registered in a civilian household in Xiangcheng County 襄城縣, Xu Subprefecture 許州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a Supernumerary Student of the County School; specializes in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Ruihua 瑞化; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Yangao 彥高; his grandfather was Feng Xi 璽; his father is Feng Yi 益; his mother is Lady Cao 曹氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Feng Xia 霞; his younger brother is Feng Lei 雷. He married Lady He 何氏. He placed fifty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王開，貫直隸保定府清苑縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字維泰，行二，年三十六，八月初七日生。曾祖浩〔壽官〕；祖恩〔知縣，累贈中憲大夫、都察院右僉都御史〕；父德純〔縣丞，贈承德郎、刑部主事〕；母孫氏〔贈安人〕。永感下。兄閾〔府同知〕、閥〔貢士〕、闉〔知府〕；弟闕、閔。娶楊氏，繼娶高氏。順天府鄉試第五十名，會試第一百八十三名。

王鳳竹，貫直隸順德府唐山縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字允在，行四，年二十七，二月十七日生。曾祖鎮；祖密〔監察御史〕；父都〔教諭〕；前母喬氏，母陳氏。具慶下。兄鳳曆、鳳鳴、鳳岐；弟鳳賡。娶張氏，繼娶趙氏。順天府鄉試第一百三十名，會試第二百六十六名。

李化龍，貫直隸大名府長垣縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字于田，行二，年二十一，三月初十日生。曾祖誠〔縣丞〕；祖繼古；父棟；母吳氏。重慶下。兄雲龍。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第二名，會試第十八名。

劉弘道，貫太醫院醫籍，直隸蘇州府吳縣人，吳縣學附學生，治《易經》，字志甫，行一，年三十二，十一月十八日生。曾祖會；祖炳；父承宗；母何氏。具慶下。弟弘度、弘德、弘義、弘毅。娶伍氏。應天府鄉試第一百名，會試第一百六十三名。
translation_en:
Wang Kai 王開, registered under a commoner household in Qingyuan County 清苑縣, Baoding Prefecture 保定府, Zhili 直隸, is a student in the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Weitai 維泰, he is the second son in his generation, and he is thirty-six sui, born on the seventh day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Hao 王浩 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Wang En 王恩 (District Magistrate, posthumously promoted in steps to Grand Master Exemplar and Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate); his father was Wang Dechun 王德純 (Assistant District Magistrate, posthumously titled Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); and his mother was née Sun 孫氏 (posthumously titled Mistress of Peace). Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Wang Yu 王閾 (Prefectural Vice Magistrate), Wang Fa 王閥 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), and Wang Yin 王闉 (Prefect); his younger brothers are Wang Que 王闕 and Wang Min 王閔. He married née Yang 楊氏, and remarried née Gao 高氏. He placed 50th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 183rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fengzhu 王鳳竹, registered under a commoner household in Tangshan County 唐山縣, Shunde Prefecture 順德府, Zhili, is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry. His courtesy name is Yunzai 允在, he is the fourth son in his generation, and he is twenty-seven sui, born on the seventeenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhen 王鎮; his grandfather was Wang Mi 王密 (Investigating Censor); his father is Wang Du 王都 (Instructor); his father's former wife was née Qiao 喬氏, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Fengli 王鳳曆, Wang Fengming 王鳳鳴, and Wang Fengqi 王鳳岐; his younger brother is Wang Fenggeng 王鳳賡. He married née Zhang 張氏, and remarried née Zhao 趙氏. He placed 130th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 266th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hualong 李化龍, registered under a commoner household in Changyuan County 長垣縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili, is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Yutian 于田, he is the second son in his generation, and he is twenty-one sui, born on the tenth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Li Cheng 李誠 (Assistant District Magistrate); his grandfather is Li Jigu 李繼古; his father is Li Dong 李棟; and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Li Yunlong 李雲龍. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 2nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 18th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Hongdao 劉弘道, registered under a medical household in the Imperial Academy of Medicine, is a native of Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Zhili, and a Supernumerary Student of the Wu County School specializing in the Classic of Changes. His courtesy name is Zhifu 志甫, he is the first son in his generation, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the eighteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Hui 劉會; his grandfather was Liu Bing 劉炳; his father is Liu Chengzong 劉承宗; and his mother is née He 何氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Liu Hongdu 劉弘度, Liu Hongde 劉弘德, Liu Hongyi 劉弘義, and Liu Hongyi 劉弘毅. He married née Wu 伍氏. He placed 100th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 163rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

王一言〔貫江西建昌府南城縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字民法，行八，年三十六，三月十五日生〕。曾祖珍〔王府引禮舍人〕，祖廉，父湧〔監生〕，母張氏。重慶下。弟一元、一揆、一科、一龍、一舉、一正、一本、一鳳、一經、一成。娶梅氏。江西鄉試第六十四名，會試第一百五名。

王國賓〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，無錫縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字用卿，行二，年三十六，八月初一日生〕。曾祖達，祖澄，父應奎，母薛氏。慈侍下。兄國賢。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第四十一名，會試第五十六名。

俞良史〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣民籍，長洲縣人，吳縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字天榮，行三，年三十一，十一月十三日生〕。曾祖士悅〔光祿大夫、太子太保兼刑部尚書〕，祖璋〔贈光祿寺典簿〕，父元弼〔知縣〕，前母張氏〔封孺人〕，繼母吳氏，生母郭氏。慈侍下。兄良知、良士，弟良裔。娶劉氏。應天府鄉試第四十四名，會試第二百九十一名。

吳謙〔貫四川瀘州民籍，州學生，治《書經》，字原豫，行四，年三十，二月初一日生〕。曾祖伯洪，祖自良，父鵬翼，母胡氏。永感下。兄詔、講，弟讓。娶丘氏。四川鄉試第六十五名，會試第一百八十名。
translation_en:
Wang Yiyan 王一言 [registered in a commoner household in Nancheng County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a District Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Minfa; eighth in generational seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the fifteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhen [Usher in a Princely Establishment]; his grandfather is Wang Lian; his father is Wang Yong [Student of the Directorate of Education]; his mother is Lady Zhang. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Yiyuan, Yikui, Yike, Yilong, Yiju, Yizheng, Yiben, Yifeng, Yijing, and Yicheng. He married Lady Mei. He placed sixty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Guobin 王國賓 [registered in a commoner household in Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a native of Wuxi County; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongqing; second in generational seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the first day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Da; his grandfather was Wang Cheng; his father was Wang Yingkui; his mother is Lady Xue. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brother is Guoxian. He married Lady Zhang. He placed forty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Liangshi 俞良史 [registered in a commoner household in Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a native of Changzhou County; an Added Student of the Wu County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tianrong; third in generational seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Shiyue [Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and concurrently Minister of Justice]; his grandfather was Yu Zhang [posthumously honored as Libationer-Recorder of the Court of Imperial Entertainments]; his father was Yu Yuanbi [District Magistrate]; his father's first wife was Lady Zhang [invested as Child-Nurturess (ruren)]; his stepmother is Lady Wu; his birth mother is Lady Guo. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Liangzhi and Liangshi, and his younger brother is Liangyi. He married Lady Liu. He placed forty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Qian 吳謙 [registered in a commoner household in Luzhou, Sichuan; a Subprefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yuanyu; fourth in generational seniority; aged thirty, born on the first day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Bohong; his grandfather was Wu Ziliang; his father was Wu Pengyi; his mother was Lady Hu. Both his parents have passed away. His elder brothers are Zhao and Jiang, and his younger brother is Rang. He married Lady Qiu. He placed sixty-fifth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

謝杰〔貫福建福州府長樂縣軍籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字漢甫，行九，年三十四，三月二十四日生〕。曾祖孟安〔封知府〕；祖士穆〔贈戶部主事〕；父廷衮〔教諭〕；前母髙氏，母林氏。永感下。兄煕、黙、煦。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第八十三名，會試第二十二名。

周夢暘〔貫湖廣襄陽府南漳縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字啓明，行一，年二十八，十月初八日生〕。曾祖禰；祖于德；父可學；嫡母蕭氏，生母王氏。慈侍下。弟夢吉。娶李氏，繼娶劉氏。湖廣鄉試第五十四名，會試第一百六十五名。

顧爾行〔貫浙江湖州府歸安縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字慎卿，行一，年三十五，四月十二日生〕。曾祖佐〔七品散官〕；祖𪨗〔壽官〕；父震〔知縣〕；母茅氏，繼母沈氏。重慶下。兄爾言；弟爾志、爾德、爾力、爾功。娶施氏。順天府鄉試第四名，會試第一百四十七名。

吳應奎〔貫山東兖州府東平州軍籍，州學生，治《詩經》，字孟才，行三，年三十二，十月十六日生〕。曾祖聰；祖仲宏〔七品散官〕；父道南〔冠帶生員〕；母田氏。具慶下。兄應乾〔驛丞〕、應台；弟應宿、應辰、應祥、應旂、應璧、應鐘、應斗、應井。娶王氏。山東鄉試第十一名，會試第一百七十二名。
translation_en:
Xie Jie 謝杰 [registered under a military household in Changle County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a supernumerary student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hanfu; ninth in his generation; age thirty-four; born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Meng'an [invested with the title of Prefect]; his grandfather was Xie Shimu [posthumously invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father was Xie Tinggun [Instructor]; his father's first wife was née Gao, and his mother was née Lin. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xie Xi, Xie Mo, and Xie Xu. He married a woman née Chen. He placed eighty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Mengyang 周夢暘 [registered under a civilian household in Nanzhang County, Xiangyang Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Qiming; first in his generation; age twenty-eight; born on the eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Mi; his grandfather was Zhou Yude; his father was Zhou Kexue; his legal mother is née Xiao, and his birth mother is née Wang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brother is Zhou Mengji. He married a woman née Li, and subsequently married a woman née Liu. He placed fifty-fourth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Erxing 顧爾行 [registered under a civilian household in Gui'an County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student in the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shenqing; first in his generation; age thirty-five; born on the twelfth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Zuo [Prestige Official of the seventh rank]; his grandfather is Gu □ [𪨗] [Honorary Official Held in Respect for His Age]; his father is Gu Zhen [District Magistrate]; his mother was née Mao, and his stepmother is née Shen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Gu Eryan; his younger brothers are Gu Erzhi, Gu Erde, Gu Erli, and Gu Ergong. He married a woman née Shi. He placed fourth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yingkui 吳應奎 [registered under a military household in Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the subprefectural school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mengcai; third in his generation; age thirty-two; born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Cong; his grandfather was Wu Zhonghong [Prestige Official of the seventh rank]; his father is Wu Daonan [Government Student granted official cap and belt]; his mother is née Tian. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Yingqian [Postal Relay Station Master] and Wu Yingtai; his younger brothers are Wu Yingsu, Wu Yingchen, Wu Yingxiang, Wu Yingqi, Wu Yingbi, Wu Yingzhong, Wu Yingdou, and Wu Yingjing. He married a woman née Wang. He placed eleventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Jingxing 王景星: Native of Xiaoshan County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, of civilian household registration; an added student (zengguangsheng) of the County Confucian School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhongxiang; second in his generation; aged twenty-six, born on the third day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Qi 琦; his grandfather was Wang Ao 鰲; his father was Wang Wulie 武烈; and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Jingyang 景暘; his younger brother is Jingxuan 景暄. He married née Yang 楊氏. He placed 32nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 217th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Minzhi 林民止: Native of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian household registration; Instructor (jiaoyu) of the Puqi County Confucian School in Huguang, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jingfu; second in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Lin Hongren 弘仁; his grandfather was Lin Minyi 敏儀 (posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father is Lin Yunzong 允宗 (Prefect, successively promoted to Grand Master for Proper Consultation); his father's former wife was née Huang 黃氏 (posthumously honoured as Mistress of Peace); and his mother was née Gu 顧氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace). His father is living. His elder brothers are Minji 民極 and Minmu 民牧; his younger brothers are Minyue 民悅 (tribute student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier, gongshi), Minshun 民順, Minhuai 民懷, and Minwang 民望. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed 90th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 65th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ji 陳濟: Native of Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, of civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Daoxing; second in his generation; aged thirty, born on the twenty-seventh day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Chen Dan 紞; his grandfather was Chen Zan 讚 (Master of Ceremonies in a princely establishment); his father is Chen Ning 寧 (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is née Cai 蔡氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Han 漢, Zhu 洙, Ji 汲, and Jun 浚; his younger brother is Pu 溥. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 45th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 234th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Shizhang 徐師張: Native of Yongkang County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, of civilian household registration; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Weijing; thirty-fifth in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Xu Xian 憲 (posthumously honoured as Gentleman for Literature and Investigating Censor of the Shanxi Circuit, with the added posthumous honours of Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate); his grandfather was Xu Yi 誼 (Medical Prefectural or County Instructor); his father is Xu Wencan 文璨; and his mother was née Chen 陳氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Shigao 師皋 (Prefect), Shiji 師稷 (Prefectural Assistant Prefect), Shikui 師夔 (Registrar of a Provincial Administration Commission), Shigao 師皐 [?], and Shicheng 師程; his younger brothers are Shijian 師諫 (tribute student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier, gongshi), Shibi 師畢, Shiyue 師說, Shijun 師俊, Shichang 師昌, and Shibi 師弼. He married née Lü 呂氏. He placed 12th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

張汝賢〔貫武功右衛軍籍，浙江崇德縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字用甫，行二，年二十八，四月二十日生〕。曾祖善〔壽官，贈通議大夫、太常寺卿〕；祖溥〔贈通議大夫、太常寺卿〕；父文奎〔恩例冠帶〕；前母趙氏；母王氏。慈侍下。兄汝綬、汝志、汝德；弟汝功、汝正〔南京太常寺典簿〕、汝勤、汝敬。娶徐氏。順天府鄉試第一百三名，會試第二百三十三名。
朱讓〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣軍籍，府學增廣生，治《禮記》，字次夔，行二，年三十一，四月初三日生〕。曾祖仕清；祖廷昭；父文直；母郭氏。永感下。兄謨〔府通判〕、諫、詵、諒、諶、諤；弟詠、謀。娶關氏。廣東鄉試第四十二名，會試第七十九名。
王毓陽〔貫陝西延安府綏德州民籍，州學增廣生，治《春秋》，字春裕，行一，年二十九，七月十五日生〕。曾祖智才；祖相〔縣丞〕；父訓賢〔知縣〕；嫡母孫氏；生母馬氏。具慶下。弟眺陽、眱陽。娶陳氏。陝西鄉試第五名，會試第二百九十九名。
translation_en:
Zhang Shize 張世則 (registered in a civilian household of Zhucheng County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weifan, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Heng; his grandfather was Zhang Hong; his father was Zhang Min; and his mother was née Chen. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Shilu, Shijue, Shizhen, and Shixiang. He married née Zheng. He placed fifty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Ruxian 張汝賢 (registered in a military household of the Right Artisans Guard (Wugong youwei), originally from Chongde County, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongfu, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Shan (Honorary Official for Longevity, posthumously granted the title Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices); his grandfather was Zhang Pu (posthumously granted the title Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices); his father was Zhang Wenkui (granted cap and belt by grace); his father's first wife was née Zhao; and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Rushou, Ruzhi, and Rude; his younger brothers are Rugong, Ruzheng (Archivist of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices), Ruqin, and Rujing. He married née Xu. He placed one hundred third in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Rang 朱讓 (registered in a military household of Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; an added student (zengguangsheng) of the prefectural school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Cikui, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the third day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Shiqing; his grandfather was Zhu Tingzhao; his father was Zhu Wenzhi; and his mother was née Guo. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Mo (Assistant Prefect), Jian, Shen, Liang, Chen, and E; his younger brothers are Yong and Mou. He married née Guan. He placed forty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yuyang 王毓陽 (registered in a civilian household of Suide Subprefecture, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; an added student of the subprefectural school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Chunyu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Zhicai; his grandfather was Wang Xiang (Assistant Magistrate); his father is Wang Xunxian (District Magistrate); his legal mother is née Sun; and his birth mother is née Ma. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Tiaoyang and Yiyang. He married née Chen. He placed fifth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Huang Men 黃門 [registered in a civilian household of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); supernumerary student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Daodeng 道登; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Jin 縉 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his grandfather was Huang Nanbai 南柏 [granted Official Cap and Belt by grace regulation]; his father is Huang Zhong 中, and his mother is née Qian 錢. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Huang Ge 閤, Huang Yue 鉞, Huang Fu 鈇, Huang Ju 鉅, and Huang Yong 鏞. He married née Pang 龐, and subsequently married née Qian 錢. He placed 69th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 15th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tingbang 張廷榜 [registered in a civilian household of Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Dengcai 登材; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Chuo 綽 [Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his grandfather is Zhang Zhu'en 主恩 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his father is Zhang Shiluo 師洛, and his mother is née Ye 葉. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Tingsong 廷松, Zhang Tingmu 廷木, and Zhang Tingdong 廷棟, and his younger brothers are Zhang Tingpian 廷楩 and Zhang Tingkui 廷櫆. He married née Lü 呂. He placed 60th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 187th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liao Hengji 廖恒吉 [registered in a military household of Dazhou Department, Kuizhou Prefecture, Sichuan; student of the department school; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Side 思德; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Liao Wenchang 文昌; his grandfather is Liao Jiuxing 久興 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his father is Liao Wan 完, and his mother is née Cheng 程. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Liao Mengji 蒙吉, and his younger brothers are Liao Fengji 逢吉, Liao Dunji 敦吉, Liao Zhenji 貞吉, Liao Zhanji 占吉, and Liao Yuanji 元吉. He married née Yuan 袁, and subsequently married née Cai 蔡. He placed 64th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 157th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Boyuan 唐伯元 [registered in a civilian household of Chenghai County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Renqing 仁卿; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Hong 鴻; his grandfather was Tang Yang 陽; his father is Tang Tianyin 天蔭, and his mother is née Chen 陳. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Tang Boyun 伯允. He married née Wang 王. He placed 31st in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 184th in the Metropolitan Examination.

李宗魯〔貫湖廣漢陽府漢陽縣軍籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字惟誠，行五，年二十五，九月十一日生〕。曾祖珣；祖子成；父鍊，母吳氏。具慶下。兄宗堯、宗舜、宗儒、宗孔，弟宗明、宗朝。娶朱氏。湖廣鄉試第六名，會試第一百二十九名。

translation_en:
Yang Ji 楊楫 [registered in a civilian household of Shangqiu County 商丘縣, Guide Prefecture 歸德府, Henan 河南; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuntong 允通; eighth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-eight; born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Jin 瑾; his grandfather was Yang Qi 祺; his father was Yang Jingdao 景道, and his mother was née Jia 賈氏. His mother is alive and his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brothers are Yang Xiao 校 [Student of the Imperial Academy (jiansheng)], Yang Nan 楠 [Administrative Assistant of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], Yang Bai 栢 [Surveillance Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission], Yang Ke 柯, Yang Kang 亢, Yang Ti 梯, and Yang Bang 榜 [Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner]. He married née Song 宋氏, and subsequently married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 54th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 283rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Sanzhai 王三宅 [registered in a military household of the Thousand-Household Battalion of Weihui Prefecture 衛輝府, Henan 河南, native of Ji County 汲縣; County Student (xianxuesheng); specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Rensuo 仁所; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight; born on the eleventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Qing 卿 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his grandfather was Wang Shi'en 施恩 [Government Student with Honorary Cap and Belt (guandai shengyuan)]; his father is Wang Lian 𦕅, his mother was née Li 李氏, and his stepmothers are née Yu 于氏 and née Yu 俞氏. His father is alive and his mother is deceased (yanshixia). His younger brothers are Wang Sanjun 三俊, Wang Sanxi 三錫, Wang Sanhuai 三槐, Wang Sancai 三才, and Wang Sance 三策. He married née He 何氏. He placed 80th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 226th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zonglu 李宗魯 [registered in a military household of Hanyang County 漢陽縣, Hanyang Prefecture 漢陽府, Huguang 湖廣; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Weicheng 惟誠; fifth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-five; born on the eleventh day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Xun 珣; his grandfather was Li Zicheng 子成; his father is Li Lian 鍊, and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. Both of his parents are alive (juqingxia). His elder brothers are Li Zongyao 宗堯, Li Zongshun 宗舜, Li Zongru 宗儒, and Li Zongkong 宗孔, and his younger brothers are Li Zongming 宗明 and Li Zongchao 宗朝. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed 6th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 129th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Rang 伍讓 [registered in a military household of Hengyang County 衡陽縣, Hengzhou Prefecture 衡州府, Huguang 湖廣; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Ziqian 子謙; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four; born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Yin 音; his grandfather was Wu Xiang 相; his father is Wu Dajun 大鈞 [Jail Warden], his mother was née Zhu 朱氏, and his stepmother is née Yuan 袁氏. Both of his father and stepmother are alive (juqingxia). His younger brothers are Wu Zhao 詔, Wu Xie 諧 [Student of the Imperial Academy (jiansheng)], Wu Yong 詠, and Wu Shi 詩. He married née Zhou 周氏, and subsequently married née Xie 謝氏. He placed 14th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 18th in the Metropolitan Examination.

孫健〔貫雲南鶴慶府軍籍，浙江餘姚縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字用純，行一，年二十七，正月十一日生〕。曾祖翯〔壽官〕；祖愉〔訓導〕；父守成；母彭氏。永感下，弟佲、倌、佶。娶高氏。雲南鄉試第六名，會試第一百九十九名。

王致中〔貫陝西寧羌衛軍籍，直隸常州府無錫縣人，南鄭縣學生，治《詩經》，字懋和，行四，年二十八，九月二十四日生〕。曾祖鐸〔州同知〕；祖良貴〔監生〕；父胤；母陳氏。具慶下，兄建中、立中、行中。娶張氏，繼娶蘇氏。陝西鄉試第四十名，會試第一百八十八名。

translation_en:
Zhu Hanchen 朱翰臣 [registered in a military banner household of Pingshan Guard in Shandong, originally from Taixing County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xuefu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Hai [Honorary Official for Longevity (Shouguan)]; his grandfather was Zhu Jing; his father was Zhu Xiu [Subordinate Ritual Official (Shengjiguan)]; and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living (his father having passed away), and his younger brothers are Shouchen, Fuchen, and Fanchen. He married née Yang. He placed fifty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Jian 孫健 [registered in a military household in Heqing Prefecture, Yunnan, originally from Yuyao County, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yongchun, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Hao [Honorary Official for Longevity (Shouguan)]; his grandfather was Sun Yu [Assistant Instructor (Xundao)]; his father was Sun Shoucheng; and his mother was née Peng. Both of his parents have passed away, and his younger brothers are Ming, Guan, and Ji. He married née Gao. He placed sixth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhizhong 王致中 [registered in a military household of Ningqiang Guard in Shaanxi, originally from Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Nanzheng County School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maohe, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Duo [Subprefectural Vice Magistrate (Zhou tongzhi)]; his grandfather was Wang Lianggui [National University Student (Jiansheng)]; his father is Wang Yin; and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living, and his elder brothers are Jianzhong, Lizhong, and Xingzhong. He married née Zhang, and subsequently married née Su. He placed fortieth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yiqian 李以謙 [registered in a civilian household in Yutai County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; County School Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Congji, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yi; his grandfather is Li Jiang; his father is Li Chong [Honorary Official for Longevity (Shouguan)]; and his mother is née Shi. Both of his parents and his grandparents are living, and his younger brother is Mingqian. He married née Yu. He placed fifty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.
