translation_en:
Shu Bangru 舒邦儒 (registered in a civilian household of Yugan County 餘干縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi; County Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zhenqing 真卿; first in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-seven; born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Shu Hao 昊 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his grandfather was Shu Lang 琅 (granted cap and belt by grace); his father is Shu Lian 蓮; his mother was Madam Zhang 章氏, and his stepmother is Madam Li 李氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Shu Bangshi 邦仕 and Shu Bangfu 邦傅; his younger brothers are Shu Bangyan 邦儼, Shu Bangbao 邦保, Shu Bangdian 邦佃, Shu Bangyi 邦佾, and Shu Bangjun 邦儁. He married Madam Zhou 周氏. He ranked 86th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Shen 陳紳 (registered in a saltern household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian, a native of Xianyou County 仙遊縣; Supernumerary Student of the Xianyou County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Guanpei 觀佩; first in seniority; age twenty-nine; born on the eleventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Chen Dewu 德五; his grandfather was Chen Jingfu 靜夫; his father is Chen Xiaodeng 肖登, and his mother is Madam Wu 吳氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Fei 緋, Chen Xiao 綃, Chen Lun 綸, Chen Qi 綺, Chen Jiong 絅, and Chen Si 絲. He married Madam Zou 鄒氏. He ranked 34th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 44th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Jizu 董繼祖 (registered in a civilian household of Luoyang County 洛陽縣, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Chengfang 承芳; first in seniority; age thirty-one; born on the seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Dong Qin 欽; his grandfather was Dong Yuan 源; his father is Dong Ce 策 (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father's former wife was Madam Yang 楊氏, and his mother is Madam Hou 侯氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brother is Dong Shaozu 紹祖. He married Madam Wei 韋氏. He ranked 48th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 278th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Shida 李士達 (registered in a military household of Sanyuan County 三原縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Boshun 伯順; first in seniority; age twenty-eight; born on the sixth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Li Ze 澤 (Public-spirited Official); his grandfather was Li Bangning 邦寧; his father is Li Xiren 希仁, and his mother is Madam Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brother is Li Shikui 士逵. He married Madam Zan 昝氏. He ranked 61st in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 75th in the Metropolitan Examination.

鄭材〔貫直隸保定府安肅縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字思成，行一，年二十二，正月初十日生〕。曾祖隆〔義官〕，祖昱〔貢士，贈推官〕，父洛〔布政司右布政使〕，母陳氏〔封孺人〕。具慶下，兄珪、杞、標，弟樸、棐、集。娶張氏。順天府鄉試第九十五名，會試第一百十九名。
李得祐〔貫四川叙州府宜賓縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字天吉，行一，年二十四，十二月十五日生〕。曾祖翰〔進士〕，祖有為，父纘，母陳氏。重慶下，弟得祺、得禎、得祥、得祉、得祚。娶王氏。四川鄉試第十七名，會試第一百三十八名。
translation_en:
Wu Ding 吳定 [registered in a commoner household in Anyang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zide; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Sheng, his grandfather was Wu Bin, his father was Wu Hai, and his mother was Lady Gong. His mother is living; his younger brothers are Wu An, Wu Ning, Wu You, and Wu Mi; he married Lady Zheng. He placed 2nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhuo Shiyan 卓世彥 [registered in a military household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, originally from Suining County, Pizhou Department, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Kaifeng Prefectural Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Bangmei; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhuo Quan [Ceremonial Guard in a Princely Establishment], his grandfather was Zhuo Chun [Ceremonial Guard in a Princely Establishment], his father was Zhuo Bolong, and his mother was Lady Wang. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Zhuo Shiguan, Zhuo Shiyue, Zhuo Shishou, Zhuo Shiran, and Zhuo Shilun; he married Lady Song. He placed 31st in the Henan Provincial Examination and 195th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Cai 鄭材 [registered in a commoner household in Ansu County, Baoding Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Sicheng; first in seniority in his line; age twenty-two, born on the tenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Long [Honorary Official], his grandfather was Zheng Yu [Tribute Student, posthumously conferred the title of Prefectural Judge], his father is Zheng Luo [Right Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission], and his mother is Lady Chen [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both parents are living; his elder brothers (or cousins) are Zheng Gui, Zheng Qi, and Zheng Biao, and his younger brothers are Zheng Pu, Zheng Fei, and Zheng Ji; he married Lady Zhang. He placed 95th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 119th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Deyou 李得祐 [registered in a commoner household in Yibin County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan; Added County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tianji; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Han [metropolitan graduate (jinshi)], his grandfather is Li Youwei, his father is Li Zuan, and his mother is Lady Chen. Both parents and grandparents are living; his younger brothers are Li Deqi, Li Dezhen, Li Dexiang, Li Dezhi, and Li Dezuo; he married Lady Wang. He placed 17th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

顧夢鯉〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字仲龍，行二，年二十九，七月二十四日生〕。曾祖杰；祖宗振；父鉞；前母蔡氏；母李氏。具慶下，兄夢鶴〔貢士〕，弟夢麟、夢竜，娶楊氏。應天府鄉試第二十六名，會試第六名。

translation_en:
Zhou Hongyue 周弘爚 (registered in a civilian household of Macheng County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yuanfu; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhu (District Magistrate, posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Zhou Tingzheng (Surveillance Vice Commissioner, promoted in prestige rank to Grand Master Exemplar); his father is Zhou Yi (Vice Magistrate, invested as Investigating Censor); and his mother is Lady Wang (invested as Child Nurturer). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Hongzuo, Hongzu (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), Hongli (granted cap and belt by grace), Honggu, Hongzhi, Hongqi (Tribute Student), and Hongbu (Student of the Directorate of Education); his younger brothers are Hongyou, Honghe, and Hongzhen. He married Lady Wang. He placed 5th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 25th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Sanyu 王三餘 (registered in a military household of Anping County, Jin Subprefecture, Zhending Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xiaoqin; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Rang; his grandfather was Wang Zhi; his father was Wang Xun (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is Lady Li. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Sanhuai (Tribute Student), Sange, and Sanshou. He married Lady Yang. He placed 19th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 300th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Mengli 顧夢鯉 (registered in a civilian household of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhonglong; second in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Gu Jie; his grandfather was Gu Zongzhen; his father is Gu Yue; his father's former wife was Lady Cai; and his mother is Lady Li. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Menghe (Tribute Student), and his younger brothers are Menglin and Menglong. He married Lady Yang. He placed 26th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 6th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Youshou 程有守 (registered in a civilian household of She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili; a Supernumerary Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Siyue; second in seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Lansun; his grandfather was Cheng Qi; his father was Cheng Duo; and his mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brother is Youwei. He married Lady Luo. He placed 123rd in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 215th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Fan Lai 范淶 [native of Xiuning County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili), of commoner household registration; an added student (zengguang sheng) of the Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanyi, fourth in generational seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Xianning; his grandfather was Fan Yanzhou; his father was Fan Ju, his father's former wives were Lady Chen, Lady Wu, and Lady Su, and his mother was Lady Hu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Fan Han, Fan Qu, and Fan Hong. He married Lady Huang. He placed 130th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 210th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zhengmo 陳正謨 [native of Nanping County, Yanping Prefecture, Fujian, of commoner household registration; a student of the Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zongyu, fourth in generational seniority, aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Xian; his grandfather was Chen Shen [District Magistrate]; his father was Chen Ying'e [Department Magistrate], and his mother was Lady Huang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Chen Zhengxue, Chen Zhengdui, and Chen Zhengfan, and his younger brothers are Chen Zhenglun, Chen Zhengdao, Chen Zhengyi, and Chen Zhengce. He married Lady Zhang. He placed 14th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 240th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Ruiyun 楊瑞雲 [native of Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, of commoner household registration; an added student (zengguang sheng) of the Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xiaohan, first in generational seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the tenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Rong; his grandfather was Yang Shen; his father was Yang Zuo [District Magistrate], and his mother was Lady Huang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Yang Xi, and his younger brother is Yang Ruixing. He married Lady Qiu. He placed 61st in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Daozhan 黃道瞻 [native of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of military and salt-producer household registration; a supernumerary student (fuxue sheng) of the Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Linru, second in generational seniority, aged twenty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Fu; his grandfather was Huang Chao; his father was Huang Kezhen, his mother was Lady Zhao, and his stepmother is Lady Wang. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Huang Wenwei, and his younger brothers are Huang Wencan, Huang Wenshen, Huang Wenhua, and Huang Wenzhen. He married Lady Wang, and remarried Lady Fu. He placed 62nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 192nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

余啓元〔貫直隸徽州府婺源縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字伯貞，行二，年三十二，八月十九日生〕。曾祖炅，祖垠，父純質，母宋氏。具慶下。兄初元，弟咨元、台元、嗣元。娶俞氏。應天府鄉試第七十五名，會試第五十九名。

朱正色〔貫直隸順德府南和縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字應明，行一，年三十一，十月三十日生〕。曾祖鉞，祖隆，父家卿，母王氏。重慶下。娶左氏。順天府鄉試第一百十七名，會試第二百五十一名。

田大年〔貫四川重慶府定遠縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字仰彭，行一，年二十八，十月十七日生〕。曾祖臣〔監生〕，祖賜〔訓導〕，父騰〔貢士〕，母何氏。具慶下。弟大倫、大益、大本、大受。娶黃氏。四川鄉試第五十九名，會試第五十三名。

陳應芳〔貫直隸揚州府泰州守禦千戶所官籍，江西吉安府泰和縣人，州學生，治《春秋》，字世龍，行二，年三十，正月十一日生〕。曾祖佐〔壽官〕，祖鳶〔恩例千戶〕，父汲〔刑部主事〕，母潘氏。慈侍下。兄應揚，弟應旂、應旌、應舜、應徵。娶周氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十八名，會試第二百七十九名。
translation_en:
Yu Qiyuan 余啓元, registered in a commoner household in Wuyuan County 婺源縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, is a County Student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Bozhen 伯貞, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Yu Jiong 炅, his grandfather Yu Yin 垠, his father Yu Chunzhi 純質, and his mother née Song 宋氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). He has an elder brother, Yu Chuyuan 初元, and younger brothers, Yu Ziyuan 咨元, Yu Taiyuan 台元, and Yu Siyuan 嗣元; he is married to née Yu 俞氏. He placed seventy-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Zhengse 朱正色, registered in a commoner household in Nanhe County 南和縣, Shunde Prefecture 順德府, Northern Metropolitan Area 直隸, is a Prefectural Student (fu xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Odes (Shijing), with the courtesy name Yingming 應明, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhu Yue 鉞, his grandfather Zhu Long 隆, his father Zhu Jiaqing 家卿, and his mother née Wang 王氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). He is married to née Zuo 左氏. He placed 117th in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 251st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Danian 田大年, registered in a commoner household in Dingyuan County 定遠縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川, is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Yangpeng 仰彭, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Tian Chen 臣 (National University Student [jiansheng]), his grandfather Tian Ci 賜 (Assistant Instructor [xundao]), his father Tian Teng 騰 (Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier [gongshi]), and his mother née He 何氏. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers, Tian Dalun 大倫, Tian Dayi 大益, Tian Daben 大本, and Tian Dashou 大受; he is married to née Huang 黃氏. He placed fifty-ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yingfang 陳應芳, registered in an official military household of the Taizhou Independent Battalion 泰州守禦千戶所 in Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, and originally from Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西, is a Subprefectural Student (zhou xuesheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), with the courtesy name Shilong 世龍, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the eleventh day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Chen Zuo 佐 (Honorary Official for Longevity [shouguan]), his grandfather Chen Yuan 鳶 (Battalion Commander by Special Grace [enli qianhu]), his father Chen Ji 汲 (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice [xingbu zhushi]), and his mother née Pan 潘氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). He has an elder brother, Chen Yingyang 應揚, and younger brothers, Chen Yingqi 應旂, Chen Yingjing 應旌, Chen Yingshun 應舜, and Chen Yingzheng 應徵; he is married to née Zhou 周氏. He placed 138th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 279th in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳竒謀〔貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣，民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字嘉猷，行一，年二十七，八月初五日生〕。曾祖富；祖玉；父熬；母湯氏。具慶下。弟竒策、竒蘊、竒勲。娶吳氏。浙江鄉試第四十名，會試第九十六名。

沈汝梁〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣，軍籍，府學附學生，治《詩經》，字邦楨，行二，年三十，五月三十日生〕。曾祖道宏〔七品散官〕；祖子相；父同尚〔恩例典樂〕；母陳氏，繼母胡氏。具慶下。兄汝棟；弟汝材〔太醫院吏目〕、汝柱、汝樟、汝校、汝松。娶王氏。福建鄉試第七十六名，會試第二百三名。

趙維魚〔貫山東濟南府齊河縣，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字夢龍，行三，年三十八，八月十五日生〕。曾祖禎〔所大使〕；祖符節；父瑞卿〔選貢生〕；母王氏。永感下。兄維熊、維羆。娶王氏，繼娶劉氏。山東鄉試第二名，會試第四十六名。
translation_en:
Chen Yifang 陳一魴 [registered in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, under military household status; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Juncong; third in his generation; aged thirty, born on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zhiliang; his grandfather was Chen Jingbi [Administrative Clerk of a Guard]; his father was Chen Xuan [Instructor]; and his mother is née Song. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Yi'ao and Chen Yikun; his younger brothers are Chen Yikui and Chen Yijia. He married née Xu. He placed seventy-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Qimou 陳竒謀 [registered in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jiayou; first in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Fu; his grandfather was Chen Yu; his father is Chen Ao; and his mother is née Tang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Chen Qice, Chen Qiyun, and Chen Qixun. He married née Wu. He placed fortieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Ruliang 沈汝梁 [registered in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under military household status; a Supplementary Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bangzhen; second in his generation; aged thirty, born on the thirtieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Daohong [Prestige Official of the Seventh Rank]; his grandfather was Shen Zixiang; his father is Shen Tongshang [Director of Music by special grace]; his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Hu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Shen Rudong; his younger brothers are Shen Rucai [Chief Steward of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], Shen Ruzhu, Shen Ruzhang, Shen Rujiao, and Shen Rusong. He married née Wang. He placed seventy-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Weiyu 趙維魚 [registered in Qihe County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, under military household status; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Menglong; third in his generation; aged thirty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Zhen [Battalion Commissioner-in-chief]; his grandfather was Zhao Fujie; his father was Zhao Ruiqing [ Tribute Student by Special Selection]; and his mother was née Wang. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhao Weixiong and Zhao Weipi. He married née Wang, and remarried née Liu. He placed second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Wenjiong 陳文炅 [registered in Linchuan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household status; prefectural student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruhui; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Xuchu; his grandfather was Chen Ji; his father is Chen Zhao; his mother is née Min. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Wenchang, Chen Wenwei, Chen Wenyao, and Chen Wensui [Investigating Censor]; his younger brothers are Chen Wenhuan [Confucian Scholar], Chen Wenhe, Chen Wenbao, Chen Wenxi, Chen Wenzhi, Chen Wenxuan, and Chen Wenzhao. He married née Xu. He placed twenty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Mengshuo 蔡夢說 [registered in Longyan County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under military household status, originally from Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture; county student of Longyan County specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Junbi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Yuanyou; his grandfather was Cai Jujing; his father is Cai Mo [District Magistrate]; his mother is née Xu. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Cai Mengzhou and Cai Mengdan. He married née Qiu. He placed fifty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Mei 高梅 [registered in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, under civilian household status; student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Rudiao; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Gao Gongtang; his grandfather was Gao Gang [granted the title of Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue]; his father is Gao Shiyan [Left Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission]; his mother was née Zhou [granted the title of Mistress of Peace]. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Gao Wu; his younger brothers are Gao Huai, Gao Ji, Gao Gui, Gao Zhu, Gao Sui, Gao Bing, and Gao Bai. He married née Tang. He placed sixty-third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Du 李杜 [registered in Yongnian County, Guangping Prefecture, Southern/Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under civilian household status; prefectural student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Guzhe; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Wang; his grandfather was Li Rui; his father is Li Yingqian [government student granted official cap and belt]; his mother was née Jia; his stepmother is née Yin. Both father and stepmother are living. He married née Shen. He placed one hundred fifteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王邦俊〔貫陝西延安府鄜州民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字士賢，行一，年二十七，三月二十四日生〕。曾祖恕；祖鳳儀〔監生〕；父瀾〔歲貢生〕；母雷氏。具慶下。弟邦秀。娶宋氏。陝西鄉試第四十六名，會試第二百七十三名。

葉遵〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《禮記》，字子憲，行十二，年二十六，三月十六日生〕。曾祖譜；祖蘭；父鳴〔冠帶生員〕；前母夏氏，母趙氏。具慶下。兄選〔工部郎中〕、遴〔恩貢生〕、之盛〔知縣〕、邁、奕、春、遂，弟遷。娶沈氏。浙江鄉試第九名，會試第一百八十五名。

李好問〔貫河南汝州魯山縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字宗舜，行一，年三十三，十月十一日生〕。曾祖友；祖華；父昂〔義官〕；母孫氏，繼母張氏。慈侍下。弟好察、好節。娶楊氏，繼娶韓氏。河南鄉試第五十一名，會試第二百二十六名。
translation_en:
He Sideng 何思登 (registered in a military household of Puqi County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yiju; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight; born on the nineteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was He Jin; his grandfather was He Wenzhi; his father is He Zhen (Instructor); his mother was née Huang, and his stepmother is née Fang. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Sijing, Silian, Sixue, and Siji. He married née Zheng. He placed eighty-first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Bangjun 王邦俊 (registered in a civilian household of Fu Subprefecture, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shixian; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven; born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wang Shu; his grandfather was Wang Fengyi (student of the Directorate of Education); his father is Wang Lan (Annual Tribute Student); his mother is née Lei. Both his parents are living. His younger brother is Bangxiu. He married née Song. He placed forty-sixth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Zun 葉遵 (registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Supernumerary Government Student of the county school; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zixian; twelfth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged twenty-six; born on the sixteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Ye Pu; his grandfather was Ye Lan; his father is Ye Ming (Government Student granted the privilege of wearing an official cap and sash); his father's former wife was née Xia, and his mother is née Zhao. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xuan (Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Works), Lin (Grace Tribute Student), Zhisheng (District Magistrate), Mai, Yi, Chun, and Sui; his younger brother is Qian. He married née Shen. He placed ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Haowen 李好問 (registered in a civilian household of Lushan County, Ru Subprefecture, Henan; an Added Government Student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zongshun; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three; born on the eleventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li You; his grandfather was Li Hua; his father was Li Ang (Honorary Official); his mother was née Sun, and his stepmother is née Zhang. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Haocha and Haojie. He married née Yang, and subsequently married née Han. He placed fifty-first in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Han Cuishan 韓萃善 [registered in a military household in Zichuan County 淄川縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; an added student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Keyi 克一; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Han Tai 韓泰; his grandfather was Han Bi 韓弼; his father was Han Siwu 韓思武 [annual tribute student (suigongsheng)]. His father's first wife was née Nie 聶, and his mother is née An 安. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Han Mingshan 韓明善 and Han Qushan 韓取善 [tribute student (gongshi)]. He married née Qiu 仇. He ranked twelfth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Yunlong 黃雲龍 [registered in a civilian household in She County 歙縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Fengyuan 逢元; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Yuanzhong 黃元仲; his grandfather was Huang Wucong 黃武琮; his father was Huang Zhixiang 黃志祥. His legal mother was née Xiang 項, and his birth mother was née Li 李. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Huang Yunpeng 黃雲鵬 [military provincial graduate (wuju)] and Huang Yuncheng 黃雲程. He married née Fang 方. He ranked ninety-third in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sima Zhi 司馬祉 [registered in a Confucian scholar household in Xia County 夏縣, Xiezhou 解州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西, originally from Kuaiji County 會稽縣, Zhejiang 浙江; a supplementary student of the Xia County school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingfu 敬甫; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Sima Tan 司馬壇; his grandfather was Sima Gongchang 司馬公韔 [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice]; his father was Sima Xiang 司馬相 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]. His mother is née Zhao 趙 [invested as Master's Wife (anren)]. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Sima Chu 司馬初 [District Magistrate], Sima Lu 司馬祿, and Sima Fa 司馬法 [student of the Directorate of Education (jiansheng)]; his younger brothers are Sima Mu 司馬牧, Sima Ji 司馬吉, and Sima Li 司馬禮. He married née Zhu 朱. He ranked twenty-eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jindao 李進道 [registered in a civilian household in Neihuang County 內黃縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mingshu 明叔; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the ninth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Xin 李信; his grandfather was Li Jin 李錦; his father was Li Ding 李頂. His mother was née Miao 苗. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Li Jinlu 李進祿; his younger brothers are Li Jinbao 李進寶, Li Jindeng 李進登, Li Jinzhong 李進忠, and Li Jinxiao 李進孝. He married née Zhang 張. He ranked eighty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Jia 王价 [registered in a civilian household of Mengjin County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Fanfu 藩甫; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the twentieth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhi 智; his grandfather was Wang Bing 昺; his father is Wang Jiqian 繼乾 [granted honorary cap and belt by grace]; his mother was née Guo 郭, and his stepmother is née Mei 梅. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Wang Hua 化, and his younger brothers are Wang Zuo 作, Wang Zhuo 倬, Wang Xiu 修, Wang Ti 倜, Wang Xi 僖, and Wang Yi 儀. He married née Xing 邢. He placed 7th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 190th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Dai 徐待 [registered in a civilian household of Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ziqi 子器; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Qian 謙; his grandfather was Xu Jie 節 [Instructor in a Princely Establishment]; his father is Xu Ming 明; his mother is née Ye 葉. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Biao 熫 and Xu Zong 倧. He married née Xie 謝. He placed 30th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 224th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Qiyan 顧起淹 [registered in a civilian household of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a native of Kunshan County; Supplementary Student in the Wu County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shifan 師范; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Qiong 瓊; his grandfather was Gu Yongling 永齡; his father was Gu Youguang 有光 [District Magistrate]; his mother is née Gong 龔. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Gu Qijin 起津 and Gu Qijing 起涇. He married née Lu 陸. He placed 13th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination (Provincial Examination) and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Tingyan 李廷彦 [registered in a military officer household of Ningxia Guard, Shaanxi, a native of Anding County, Yan'an Prefecture; Supplementary Student in the Guard School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xisheng 希聖; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Wenxian 文顯; his grandfather was Li Gong 恭; his father was Li Zigan 子幹 [Instructor in a Princely Establishment]; his father's first wife (former mother) was née Song 宋, and his mother was née Xue 薛. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Li Tingjin 廷縉 [Government Student with honorary cap and belt] and Li Tingbin 廷賓. He married née Qu 屈. He placed 44th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 143rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhu Xiqia 朱煕洽 [registered in a civilian household of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Hongfu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-one, born on the fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Zu; his grandfather was Zhu You; his father was Zhu Weixin; and his mother was née Song. Both of his parents are deceased. He married née Shen. He placed fifty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Mengzhao 熊夢兆 [registered in a civilian household of Luyi County, Guide Prefecture, Henan; a county student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yingzheng, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiong Xun; his grandfather was Xiong Xian; his father was Xiong Guangfu; and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Mengzhou and Mengbi. He married née Sun. He placed third in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Bingzhong 趙秉忠 [registered in a civilian household of Ouning County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian; a county student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jinchen, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Rong [Prefectural Administrative Clerk]; his grandfather was Zhao Yu; his father was Zhao He [Assistant Instructor]; his mother was née Gong; and his stepmother is née Zhu. His mother (stepmother) is living. His elder brother is Bingzhi, and his younger brother is Bingliang. He married née Yang. He placed first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Mei 劉美 [registered in a military household of the Chengdu Left Escort Guard, Sichuan, a native of Chengdu County; a student of the Chengdu Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Maoshi, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Yanhong; his grandfather was Liu Feng; his father was Liu Nanyang; and his mother is née Zheng. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Kan and Xian. He married née Deng, and took née Yang as his second wife. He placed thirty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Li Dian; his grandfather was Li Zhihong; his father is Li Luan; his father's former wife was Lady Wu; his mother was Lady Hu; and his stepmother is Lady Meng. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Li Xueyi, and his younger brother is Li Xueshu. He married Lady Zhou. He placed twenty-ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zuozhi 張佐治 [registered under civilian status in Pinghe County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Simou, second in seniority, age twenty-nine, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Jingjie; his grandfather was Zhang Zhenzhi; his father is Zhang Dazhen; and his mother is Lady Fang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Gui and Zhang Zanzhi; his younger brothers are Zhang Youzhi and Zhang Shunzhi. He married Lady Ou. He placed seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Maozhong 劉懋中 [registered under civilian status in Wei County, Daming Prefecture, Southern/Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kecan, first in seniority, age thirty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Jian [posthumously honored as Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his grandfather was Liu Ju [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his father was Liu Tang [Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate]; his mother was Lady Li; and his stepmother is Lady Zhang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Liu Dounan, Liu Jing, Liu Kun, Liu Yue, and Liu Douguang; his younger brothers are Liu Guangda, Liu Feng, Liu Jindao, Liu Maohe [Student of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], Liu Qin, Liu He, and Liu Ao. He married Lady Zhang. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Daonan 朱道南 [registered under official status in the Lin'an Guard in Yunnan, originally from Hefei County, Luzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a Prefectural Student of Lin'an Prefecture specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tongwen, first in seniority, age twenty-nine, born on the nineteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Yao; his grandfather is Zhu Jie; his father is Zhu Zigao; his mother was Lady Chu; and his stepmother is Lady Zeng. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He married Lady Wu. He placed first in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

饒廷錫〔貫江西南昌府進賢縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字文命，行六，年三十二，十月十四日生〕。曾祖植中；祖尚志；父世守，母聶氏，繼母王氏。慈侍下。兄廷宣，弟廷濟、廷學。娶萬氏。江西鄉試第六十五名，會試第九十七名。

孫充〔貫河南汝寧府光州固始縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字應文，行一，年三十四，九月二十五日生〕。曾祖釗；祖璉；父洲，母沈氏。具慶下。弟兌、允、亮、亢、克。娶郭氏。河南鄉試第四十九名，會試第二百四十九名。

秦應驄〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字行之，行一，年三十六，五月十五日生〕。曾祖炫；祖璽；父鍠，母李氏。具慶下。弟應鵬、應鶚〔監生〕、應鰲、應鳶、應鵷。娶馮氏。□□鄉試第七名，會試第六十名。
translation_en:
Zhan Qidong 詹啓東: Registered in a civilian household of Anxi County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, he is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Zhizhen, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-seven years old, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhan Chaoyuan; his grandfather was Zhan Ying; his father is Zhan Wen, and his mother was née Tang. His father is living. He has an elder brother Zhan Cang and a younger brother Zhan Yindong, and he is married to née Chen. He placed nineteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rao Tingxi 饒廷錫: Registered in a civilian household of Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, he is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Wenming, he is sixth in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-two years old, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Rao Zhizhong; his grandfather was Rao Shangzhi; his father was Rao Shishou, his mother was née Nie, and his stepmother is née Wang. His stepmother is living. He has an elder brother Rao Tingxuan and younger brothers Rao Tingji and Rao Tingxue, and he is married to née Wan. He placed sixty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Chong 孫充: Registered in a civilian household of Gushi County, Guang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan, he is an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Yingwen, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-four years old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Sun Zhao; his grandfather was Sun Lian; his father is Sun Zhou, and his mother is née Shen. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers Sun Dui, Sun Yun, Sun Liang, Sun Kang, and Sun Ke, and he is married to née Guo. He placed forty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Yingcong 秦應驄: Registered in a civilian household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, he is a Supplementary Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Xingzhi, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-six years old, born on the fifteenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Qin Xuan; his grandfather was Qin Xi; his father is Qin Huang, and his mother is née Li. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers Qin Yingpeng, Qin Ying'e (a Directorate Student), Qin Ying'ao, Qin Yingyuan, and Qin Yingyuan, and he is married to née Feng. He placed seventh in the [illegible] Provincial Examination and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
戈大本〔貫錦衣衛匠籍，直隸蘇州府吳縣人，國子生，治《禮記》，字性甫，行二，年三十二，五月十三日生〕。曾祖麟〔訓導〕；祖宗；父春；母劉氏。嚴侍下。兄大用，弟大化、大中。娶馮氏。順天府鄉試第六十九名，會試第二百一名。

劉汝桂〔貫山東東昌府高唐州民籍，州學生，治《詩經》，字攀甫，行一，年三十七，十月二十三日生〕。曾祖剛；祖春；父應奎〔歲貢生〕；母田氏，繼母李氏、李氏。嚴侍下。弟汝楫、汝槐、汝棟、汝欄、汝棣、汝楊。娶杜氏。山東鄉試第二十五名，會試第二百十六名。

江鐸〔貫浙江杭州府仁和縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字士振，行一，年二十七，二月二十一日生〕。曾祖瀾〔南京禮部尚書，贈太子少保，謚文昭，加贈資德大夫〕；祖曉〔通議大夫、工部右侍郎，贈工部尚書〕；父圻〔按察司提學僉事〕；母李氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。弟鉁、鏷、鍊、鏌、鉥、釪、鈖、鏄、鍰。娶許氏。浙江鄉試第九名，會試第二百五名。

丁汝謙〔貫山西平陽府吉州軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字子益，行一，年三十五，三月十八日生〕。曾祖勝；祖威〔蜀府大使〕；父良佐〔恩例冠帶〕；母張氏，繼母郅氏、張氏。具慶下。娶張氏。山西鄉試第三十四名，會試第二百三十二名。
translation_en:
Ge Daben 戈大本 (registered in an artisan household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard, originally from Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Xingfu; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Ge Lin (Assistant Instructor); his grandfather was Ge Zong; his father was Ge Chun; and his mother was née Liu. His father is living. He has an elder brother, Dayong, and younger brothers, Dahua and Dazhong. He married née Feng. He placed sixty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Rugui 劉汝桂 (registered in a civilian household of Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a subprefectural student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Panfu; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Gang; his grandfather was Liu Chun; his father was Liu Yingkui (annual tribute student); his mother was née Tian, and his stepmothers were née Li and née Li. His father is living. He has younger brothers: Ruji, Ruhuai, Rudong, Rulan, Rudi, and Ruyang. He married née Du. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Duo 江鐸 (registered in a civilian household of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; an expectant student of the county school; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shizhen; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Lan (Nanjing Minister of Rites, posthumously honoured as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Wenzhao, and further posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Assisting toward Virtue); his grandfather was Jiang Xiao (Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Minister of Works, posthumously honoured as Minister of Works); his father was Jiang Qi (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner for Education); and his mother was née Li (invested as Master's Wife). Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers: Zhen, Pu, Lian, Mo, Shu, Yu, Fen, Bo, and Huan. He married née Xu. He placed ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Ruqian 丁汝謙 (registered in a military household of Jizhou Subprefecture, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Ziyi; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Ding Sheng; his grandfather was Ding Wei (Commissioner-in-chief of the Princely Establishment of Shu); his father was Ding Liangzuo (granted cap and belt by grace); his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmothers were née Zhi and née Zhang. His father and stepmother are living. He married née Zhang. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

姚士觀〔貫江西廣信府貴溪縣軍籍，府學生，治《禮記》，字正爾，行五，年三十二，正月初三日生〕。曾祖文盛；祖伯泰；父仲璋，母鄒氏。慈侍下。兄士覲，弟士覘。娶夏氏，繼娶傅氏。江西鄉試第五名，會試第二百四十五名。

閰芹〔貫山東萊州府高密縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字時獻，行二，年三十五，二月二十五日生〕。曾祖勝；祖逵；父仲宙，母劉氏。慈侍下。兄藻〔省祭官〕，弟蘭〔太醫院冠帶醫士〕。娶馮氏。山東鄉試第四十六名，會試第一百五十九名。

李寀〔貫直隸廬州府舒城縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字邦亮，行五，年三十五，九月初六日生〕。曾祖榮；祖樂；父曰明，母徐氏。慈侍下。兄實〔壽官〕、完、宗、憲，弟寧。娶葉氏。應天府鄉試第九十三名，會試第二百九十四名。

劉朝璽〔貫江西吉安府永新縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字質之，行五，年三十六，二月初六日生〕。曾祖竒邁〔壽官〕；祖年；父天椿，母王氏。永感下。兄朝器〔冠帶生員〕、朝輔、朝弼、朝丞，弟朝典。娶王氏。江西鄉試第七十五名，會試第一百五十六名。
translation_en:
Yao Shiguan 姚士觀 [registered under a military household in Guixi County 貴溪縣, Guangxin Prefecture 廣信府, Jiangxi 江西; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zheng'er 正爾; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the third day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yao Wensheng 文盛; his grandfather was Yao Botai 伯泰; his father was Yao Zhongzhang 仲璋, and his mother was née Zou 鄒氏. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Shijin 士覲, and a younger brother, Shichan 士覘. He married née Xia 夏氏, and remarried née Fu 傅氏. He placed fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Qin 閰芹 [registered under a civilian household in Gaomi County 高密縣, Laizhou Prefecture 萊州府, Shandong 山東; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shixian 時獻; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Sheng 勝; his grandfather was Yan Kui 逵; his father was Yan Zhongzhou 仲宙, and his mother was née Liu 劉氏. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Zao 藻 [Expectant Official on Home Leave], and a younger brother, Lan 蘭 [Medical Practitioner with official cap and belt in the Imperial Academy of Medicine]. He married née Feng 馮氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Cai 李寀 [registered under a civilian household in Shucheng County 舒城縣, Luzhou Prefecture 廬州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bangliang 邦亮; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Rong 榮; his grandfather was Li Le 樂; his father was Li Yueming 曰明, and his mother was née Xu 徐氏. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Shi 實 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age], Wan 完, Zong 宗, and Xian 憲, and a younger brother, Ning 寧. He married née Ye 葉氏. He placed ninety-third in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Chaoxi 劉朝璽 [registered under a civilian household in Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhizhi 質之; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the sixth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Qimai 竒邁 [Honorary Official of Advanced Age]; his grandfather was Liu Nian 年; his father was Liu Tianchun 天椿, and his mother was née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He has elder brothers Chaoqi 朝器 [Government Student granted official cap and belt], Chaofu 朝輔, Chaobi 朝弼, and Chaocheng 朝丞, and a younger brother, Chaodian 朝典. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed seventy-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Shizhong 劉士忠 (registered in a civilian household of Huazhou in Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Chunqing; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Liu Fu; his grandfather was Liu Lian (Guard Registry); his father is Liu Daoli (Instructor); his mother was née Li, and his stepmother is née Wang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Shixiao, Shiwan, Shifan, Shibin, and Shiqi. He is married to née Wu. He placed 59th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 284th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Heng 張珩 (registered in a military household of Zhaocheng County in Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Peiqing; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Hou; his grandfather was Zhang Jie (Granary Commissioner-in-chief); his father is Zhang Dahe; his mother is née Jia. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Guan; his younger brothers are Zan and Fan. He is married to née Li. He placed 63rd in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 121st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Guifang 胡桂芳 (registered in a civilian household of Jinxi County in Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; Supernumerary Student of the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Shirong; thirty-ninth in seniority in his generation; age twenty-four, born on the fourth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Yan (Honorary Official of Advanced Age); his grandfather is Hu Guohua; his father is Hu Jian (granted cap and belt by grace regulation); his mother is née Li. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Tongfang and Zifang; his younger brothers are Huaifang, Chunfang, and Meifang. He is married to née Zheng. He placed 5th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 34th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Guozuo 王國祚 (registered in a civilian household of Cangzhou in Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shichang; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the third day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Fu; his grandfather was Wang Daochong; his father is Wang Mianxue (Honorary Official of Advanced Age); his mother is née Zhou. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Guoyin, Guojun, and Guojie. He is married to née Shi. He placed 70th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 296th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Shouji 范守己 is registered in a civilian household in Weichuan County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; he is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Jieru, second in seniority, aged twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Fan Qi 玘; his grandfather was Fan Ben 本 (Sacrificial Attendant); his father was Fan Jiu'en 九恩 (Honorary Elder); his mother is née Wang 王氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Fan Shoujie 守節. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed 19th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 198th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Nanxing 趙南星 is registered in an artisan household in Gaoyi County, Zhaozhou Subprefecture, Zhending Prefecture, Southern or Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); he is a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Gongji, first in seniority, aged twenty-five, born on the third day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Zhao Cunli 存禮 (Assistant County Magistrate); his grandfather is Zhao Zemin 澤民 (County Magistrate); his father is Zhao Rubi 汝弼; his mother is née Hou 侯氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhao Nandou 南斗 and Zhao Nanming 南明. He married née Feng 馮氏. He placed 71st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xu 陳勗 is registered in a civilian household in Ningde County, Funing Subprefecture, Fujian; he is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Shimian, ninth in seniority, aged twenty-nine, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Chen Zechun 則純; his grandfather was Chen Xiang 祥; his father was Chen Luan 鸞; his father's first wife was née Ni 倪氏; his mother was née Huang 黃氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Chen Yan 晏, Chen Gui 炅, and Chen Dan 旦. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed 69th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 72nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yujie 陳于階 is registered in a civilian household in Quzhou County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; he is a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), with the courtesy name Zisheng, second in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the seventh day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Xuan 宣 (Honorary Elder); his grandfather was Chen Sikao 思考; his father was Chen Shanli 善禮 (posthumously honoured as Vice Minister of the Seal Office, and further posthumously honoured as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices); his mother is née Zhang 張氏 (invested as Grand Mistress of Peace, and further invested as Grand Mistress of Respect). His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Chen Yubi 于陛 (Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices). He married née Qin 秦氏, and remarried née Guo 郭氏. He placed 63rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 277th in the Metropolitan Examination.

浙江鄉試第二十四名　會試第五十一名
punctuated:
楊廷相，貫福建泉州府晋江縣匠籍，國子生。治《易經》，字君賛，行一，年三十一，九月十六日生。曾祖庸〔王府左長史，贈中順大夫〕；祖深；父希程；母吳氏。永感下。兄元政、纘芳〔教諭〕、廷楠；弟廷標、廷機。娶王氏。福建鄉試第六十六名，會試第一百四十一名。

杜希鵬，貫河南河南府陝州靈寶縣匠籍，國子生。治《易經》，字化甫，行一，年三十三，十二月二十五日生。曾祖冊；祖仁美；父得然；母翟氏。慈侍下。弟希顏、希孔、希尹。娶耿氏。河南鄉試第二名，會試第一百七十八名。

邢侗，貫山東濟南府臨邑縣軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字子愿，行四，年二十四，十一月二十六日生。曾祖政〔知州〕；祖博〔教諭，贈吏科都給事中〕；父如約〔王府良醫正〕；前母趙氏；母萬氏。具慶下。兄化〔府同知〕、仕〔貢士〕、偲〔監生〕、似、佖、倬、侁、修〔監生〕、佶、倌；弟佑、作、伉。娶陳氏。順天府鄉試第九十五名，會試第二百四十二名。

支大綸，貫浙江嘉興府嘉善縣民籍，嘉興縣人，嘉善縣學生。治《書經》，字心易，行四，年三十二，四月初一日生。曾祖立〔翰林院孔目〕；祖高〔教諭〕；父祿〔訓導〕；母顧氏。具慶下。兄大緒、大烈、大經；弟可大〔同科進士〕。娶嚴氏。浙江鄉試第二十四名，會試第五十一名。
translation_en:
Yang Tingxiang 楊廷相 is registered in an artisan household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and is a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng). He specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Junzan 君賛, he is first in his family's seniority line, and he is thirty-one sui, born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Yang Yong 庸 (Left Administrator in a Princely Establishment, posthumously titled Grand Master for Governance); his grandfather was Yang Shen 深; his father was Yang Xicheng 希程; and his mother was Lady Wu 吳氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yang Yuanzheng 元政, Yang Zuanfang 纘芳 (Instructor), and Yang Tingnan 廷楠; his younger brothers are Yang Tingbiao 廷標 and Yang Tingji 廷機. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He ranked 66th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Xipeng 杜希鵬 is registered in an artisan household in Lingbao County, Shan Subprefecture, Henan Prefecture, Henan, and is a Student of the Directorate of Education. He specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Huafu 化甫, he is first in his family's seniority line, and he is thirty-three sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Du Ce 冊; his grandfather was Du Renmei 仁美; his father was Du Deran 得然; and his mother is Lady Zhai 翟氏. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His younger brothers are Du Xiyan 希顏, Du Xikong 希孔, and Du Xiyin 希尹. He married Lady Geng 耿氏. He ranked 2nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 178th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xing Tong 邢侗 is registered in a military household in Linyi County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, and is a Student of the Directorate of Education. He specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), his courtesy name is Ziyuan 子愿, he is fourth in his family's seniority line, and he is twenty-four sui, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Xing Zheng 政 (Subprefectural Magistrate); his grandfather was Xing Bo 博 (Instructor, posthumously titled Chief Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel); his father is Xing Ruyue 如約 (Chief Physician in a Princely Establishment); his father's first wife was Lady Zhao 趙氏; and his mother is Lady Wan 萬氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Xing Hua 化 (Prefectural Vice Prefect), Xing Shi 仕 (Tribute Student / Metropolitan Graduate-designate), Xing Si 偲 (Supervisorate Student), Xing Si 似, Xing Bi 佖, Xing Zhuo 倬, Xing Shen 侁, Xing Xiu 修 (Supervisorate Student), Xing Ji 佶, and Xing Guan 倌; his younger brothers are Xing You 佑, Xing Zuo 作, and Xing Kang 伉. He married Lady Chen 陳氏. He ranked 95th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 242nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhi Dalun 支大綸 is registered in a civilian household in Jiashan County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, is a native of Jiaxing County, and is a County Student of Jiashan County. He specializes in the Classic of Documents (Shujing), his courtesy name is Xinyi 心易, he is fourth in his family's seniority line, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the first day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Zhi Li 立 (Archivist of the Hanlin Academy); his grandfather was Zhi Gao 高 (Instructor); his father is Zhi Lu 祿 (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is Lady Gu 顧氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhi Daxu 大緒, Zhi Dalie 大烈, and Zhi Dajing 大經; his younger brother is Zhi Keda 可大 (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class). He married Lady Yan 嚴氏. He ranked 24th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 51st in the Metropolitan Examination.

王懋中〔貫江西建昌府南城縣民籍，國子生。治《書經》，字惟一，行十八，年三十八，正月十七日生〕。曾祖天錫，祖大倫，父國顯，母夏氏，繼母黃氏。慈侍下。兄懋德。娶梅氏。江西鄉試第九十五名，會試第四十三名。

傅好禮〔貫順天府固安縣民籍，縣學生。治《詩經》，字伯恭，行一，年三十二，十月二十日生〕。曾祖聚，祖佐，父永昌〔驛丞〕，母馮氏。慈侍下。弟好義、好信、好儉、立禮、敦禮、崇禮、明禮。娶張氏。順天府鄉試第一百三十三名，會試第二百四十七名。

何倬〔貫河南開封府杞縣匠籍，縣學生。治《詩經》，字明夫，行五，年三十三，正月初六日生〕。曾祖聚，祖景隆，父立賢〔倉大使〕，母劉氏。具慶下。兄仕〔衞經歷〕、仁、佳。娶彭氏。河南鄉試第四十七名，會試第一百七十名。

王繼明〔貫浙江温州府永嘉縣竈籍，縣學增廣生。治《詩經》，字用晦，行一，年三十，正月初六日生〕。曾祖楫，祖儼〔義官〕，父允文，母張氏。重慶下。兄如珪〔貢士〕、光蘊〔貢士〕，弟如璧〔錦衣衞副千戶〕、繼旦、繼昭。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第十五名，會試第二百十八名。
translation_en:
Wang Maozhong 王懋中 (registered as a commoner of Nancheng County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Weiyi; eighteenth in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wang Tianxi, his grandfather was Wang Dalun, his father was Wang Guoxian, his mother was Lady Xia, and his stepmother is Lady Huang. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Mao'de. He married Lady Mei. He placed ninety-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Haoli 傅好禮 (registered as a commoner of Gu'an County, Shuntian Prefecture; a County Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bogong; first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Fu Ju, his grandfather was Fu Zuo, his father was Fu Yongchang (Postal Relay Station Master), and his mother is Lady Feng. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Haoyi, Haoxin, Haojian, Lili, Dunli, Chongli, and Mingli. He married Lady Zhang. He placed 133rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 247th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Zhuo 何倬 (registered in an artisan household of Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a County Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mingfu; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was He Ju, his grandfather was He Jinglong, his father is He Lixian (Granary Commissioner-in-chief), and his mother is Lady Liu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shi (Guard Registrar), Ren, and Jia. He married Lady Peng. He placed forty-seventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and 170th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jiming 王繼明 (registered in a saltern household of Yongjia County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; an Added-quota County Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yonghui; first in seniority; aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wang Ji, his grandfather is Wang Yan (Righteous Official), his father is Wang Yunwen, and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Rugui (Tribute Scholar) and Guangyun (Tribute Scholar), and his younger brothers are Rubi (Vice Battalion Commander of the Embroidered-uniform Guard), Jidan, and Jizhao. He married Lady Yang. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 218th in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳相〔貫福建福州府閩縣民籍，府學生，治《禮記》，字以道，行三十七，年三十四，十一月十三日生〕。曾祖瓊；祖亮〔稅課司大使〕；父江，嫡母林氏，生母王氏。慈侍下。兄椿、𢢀、楠〔壽官〕、材〔倉大使〕、鳳、道〔都司斷事〕、桂、榆，弟邦、善、誠〔俱省祭官〕、榓、章、試、科、訓。娶魏氏。福建鄉試第十三名，會試第一百六十四名。

translation_en:
Zhang Mingfan 張名藩 (native of Huang County, Dengzhou Prefecture, Shandong, of military household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jiafu; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Lun (Director in the Ministry of War); his grandfather was Ping; his father is Chenglie, and his mother is née Lin. Both of his parents are living. His older brother is Pangui, and his younger brothers are Liangui and Conggui. He married née Tian. He placed thirty-sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bian Youyou 邊有猷 (native of Fengqiu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, of commoner household status; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kezhuang; first in his generation; age thirty-six, born on the sixth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Gui; his grandfather was Hong (District Jailor); his father is Shi (County Director of Studies), and his mother is née Li. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Youwei and Youshou. He married née Liu. He placed one hundredth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xiang 陳相 (native of Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, of commoner household status; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yidao; thirty-seventh in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Qiong; his grandfather was Liang (Commissioner-in-chief of a Commercial Tax Office); his father was Jiang, his legal mother was née Lin, and his birth mother is née Wang. His mother is living. His older brothers are Chun, Bo [? 𢢀], Nan (Honorary Official for Longevity), Cai (Granary Commissioner-in-chief), Feng, Dao (Judge of a Regional Military Commission), Gui, and Yu; his younger brothers are Bang, Shan, Cheng (all three Expectant Sacrificial Attendants), Mi, Zhang, Shi, Ke, and Xun. He married née Wei. He placed thirteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Dacai 蕭大才 (native of Tangyi County, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong, of military household status; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yuncheng; first in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Ci; his grandfather was Qin; his father is Shen, and his mother was née Liu. His father is living. He married née Liu. He placed forty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Gao Cui 高萃 (registered under a military household in Yin County 鄞縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; an Added Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shengbo 升伯; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Gao Qian 高謙; his grandfather was Gao Wen 高文 (Postmaster); his father is Gao Shi 高士; and his mother is née Zhou 周氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Yao 姚氏. He placed 57th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 11th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Tiqian 黃體乾 (registered under a commoner household in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili 直隸]; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Xingjian 行健; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Ji 黃濟; his grandfather was Huang Zan 黃簪 (Tribute Student); his father is Huang Dong 黃棟; his father's former wife was née Yin 尹氏; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Huang Tidao 黃體道, Huang Tili 黃體立, Huang Tikun 黃體坤, and Huang Tixin 黃體信. He married née Chu 儲氏. He placed 129th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 176th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin He 金和 (registered under a commoner household in Changzhou County 長洲縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili 直隸], a native of Wu County 吳縣; a Supplementary Student of the Changzhou County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yuanjie 元節; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the first day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Jin Pei 金佩; his grandfather was Jin Shi 金式; his father was Jin Xiang 金相; and his mother was née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Jin Zhong 金重, Jin Hong 金鋐, and Jin Li 金礪. He married née Hui 惠氏. He placed 55th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 173rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Maojian 丁懋建 (registered under a commoner household in Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Supplementary Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yuanjing 元敬; twentieth in seniority in his generation; aged thirty, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Ding Zhongxu 丁仲頊; his grandfather was Ding Liang 丁良; his father is Ding Chun 丁椿; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Ding Yaoqing 丁堯卿 (Vice Prefect, promoted in prestige title to Grand Master for Court Service); his younger brothers are Ding Ruichun 丁瑞春 (Tribute Student), Ding Shizhi 丁世茝, Ding Shipei 丁世佩, Ding Shiru 丁世儒, and Ding Shilun 丁世倫. He married née Zhou 周氏. He placed 49th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yaomin 李堯民 [registered under civilian household status in Jining Subprefecture 濟寧州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兗州府, Shandong 山東; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ruhua 汝化, first in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-five, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Li Qi 玘, his grandfather was Li Xian 顯, his father is Li Qin 勤, his legal mother is née Duan 段氏, and his birth mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Li Shunmin 舜民. He married née Diao 刁氏. He placed sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Luo 馬洛 [registered under civilian household status in Rugao County 如皋縣, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili 直隸); a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Chengshu 呈書, second in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-five, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Jizu 繼祖 [Investigating Censor], his grandfather was Ma Shen 紳 [County Magistrate], his father is Ma Yingzhen 應禎 [Battalion Commander by Special Grace], and his mother is née Xu 許氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Ma Ji 濟 [National University Student], and his younger brothers are Ma Bian 汴, Ma Hu 湖, and Ma Shu 淑. He married née Cao 曹氏. He placed one hundred and twelfth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qu Zhuo 屈灼 [registered under military household status in Pucheng County 蒲城縣, Hua Subprefecture 華州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; an Added Student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jianfu 見夫, second in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-third day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Qu Yue 鉞 [Prefect], his grandfather is Qu Ke 珂 [Prefectural Director of Studies], his father is Qu Jia 檟 [Honorary Official for Longevity], and his mother is née Xi 席氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Qu Wei 煒, and his younger brother is Qu Xuan 炫. He married née Shi 石氏. He placed seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Yingzhao 羅應兆 [registered under civilian household status in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili 直隸); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanfa 元發, first in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Luo Yi 繹, his grandfather was Luo Dehou 德厚, his father was Luo Zhao 照, his mother was née Yuan 袁氏, and his stepmother was née Xu 徐氏. Both parents are deceased. He married née Qian 錢氏. He placed thirty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Dong Qi 琦; his grandfather was Dong Cheng 澄 [Overseer of the Royal Kitchen in a Princely Establishment]; his father was Dong Mao 懋 [Secretary in the Ministry of Works]; his father's former wife was née Xu 徐, and his mother is née He 何. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Tingru 廷儒, and a younger brother, Tingshi 廷史. He married née Zhu 朱. He placed thirty-eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Shi 周詩 [registered in a civilian household in Dezhou 德州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong; student of the subprefectural school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yanzhi 言志; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zheng 政; his grandfather was Zhou Lu 祿; his father is Zhou Mengren 夢仁 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; and his mother is née Feng 馮. Both his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Shu 書, and a younger brother, Xian 憲. He married née Shen 沈, and remarried née Wang 王. He placed fortieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wen Zaizhong 文在中 [registered in a military household in Sanshui County 三水縣, Binzhou 邠州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi; student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dechong 德充; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-three, born on the fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wen Shoujing 守經; his grandfather was Wen Guan 官 [Student of the Directorate of Education]; his father is Wen Yunkai 運開 [Annual Tribute Student]; and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both his parents are living. He has younger brothers Meizhong 美中, Yuzhong 裕中, and Jizhong 積中. He married née Zhao 趙. He placed first in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Sanrang 姚三讓 [registered in a military household in Yongnian County 永年縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, Southern or Northern Zhili; student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Chongqian 崇謙; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yao Zhu 著; his grandfather is Yao Sheng 陞; his father is Yao Yan 嚴; and his mother is née Li 李. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He married née Li 李. He placed one hundred and twenty-first in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Shixiu 田時秀 (registered as a civilian household in Wan County, Baoding Prefecture, Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zishi; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the tenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Tian Zhi 志; his grandfather was Tian Yu 玉; his father is Tian Lu 魯; and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He has an elder brother, Shifu 世福, and is married to née Ge 葛氏. He placed 73rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 259th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Tengxiao 劉騰霄 (registered as a civilian household in Ansu County, Baoding Prefecture, Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student [guozisheng] specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Zichong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the seventh day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Jiang 江 ( sacrificial attendant [shengjiguan]); his grandfather was Liu Pu 普; his father is Liu Guan 貫 (Honorary Official Held in Esteem for His Great Age [shouguan]); his mother was née Zhang 張氏, and his stepmothers were née Xie 解氏 and née Xu 徐氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He has younger brothers, Tengyun 騰雲 and Tengji 騰霽; he married née Zhang 張氏 and subsequently remarried née Wang 王氏. He placed 73rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 295th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chu Shun 褚順 (registered as a civilian household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a Directorate Student [guozisheng] specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zi'an; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Chu Hong 宏; his grandfather was Chu Lin 霖; his father is Chu Chengsun 檉孫 (Assistant Prefect [fu tongpan]); and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. He is married to née Li 李氏. He placed 64th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 174th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ni Dong 倪涷 (registered as a military household in Shangyu County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Supplementary Student in the county school [xianxue fuxuesheng] specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Linzhong; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Ni Tang 堂; his grandfather is Ni Kai 鎧 (District Magistrate [zhixian]); his father is Ni Yingqi 應蘄; and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has elder brothers Mu 沐, Xiang 湘, and Shen 深, and younger brothers Di 滌, Qu 渠, and Liang 湸; he is married to née Cao 曹氏. He placed 51st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 78th in the Metropolitan Examination.
